15	[McpServerToolType]
16	public sealed class EducationTools(KnowledgeService kb, RagService rag, IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory)
17	{
18	    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions JsonOpts = new()
19	    {
20	        PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase,
21	        Encoder = JavaScriptEncoder.UnsafeRelaxedJsonEscaping
22	    };
23	
24	    private static string ToJson(object value) => JsonSerializer.Serialize(value, JsonOpts);
25	
26	    [McpServerTool(Name = "search_knowledge"), Description(
27	        "语义检索知识点知识库（RAG）。讲解、辅导、答疑前必须先调用本工具获取知识点依据，禁止凭空讲解。返回最相关的知识点及文档摘要；需要完整文档时再用 get_knowledge_node。")]
28	    public async Task<string> SearchKnowledge(
29	        [Description("检索问题，例如：三角形面积为什么要除以2")] string query,
30	        [Description("返回条数，1-5，默认3")] int topK = 3)
31	    {
32	        var hits = await rag.SearchAsync(query, Math.Clamp(topK, 1, 5));
33	        return ToJson(new { mode = rag.VectorMode ? "vector" : "keyword", hits });
34	    }
35	
36	    [McpServerTool(Name = "get_knowledge_node"), Description(
37	        "获取知识点完整教学文档（概念、算法、常见错误、例题、教学提示）。nodeId 传 tree 返回整棵知识图谱目录；传叶子节点 id（如 triangle-area）返回该知识点完整文档。")]
38	    public string GetKnowledgeNode(
39	        [Description("知识点 id，或 tree 表示查看目录")] string nodeId)
40	    {
41	        if (nodeId == "tree") return kb.GetTreeText();
42	        var node = kb.GetNode(nodeId);
43	        if (node == null) return ToJson(new { error = $"知识点不存在: {nodeId}", tree = kb.GetTreeText() });
44	        return ToJson(new { node.Id, node.Name, node.Domain, doc = kb.GetDoc(nodeId) ?? "（文档缺失）" });
45	    }
46	
47	    [McpServerTool(Name = "generate_practice"), Description(
48	        "为指定知识点生成练习题。答案由系统保存，不会返回给你，你也无法提前知道答案。一次最多5题。生成后逐题出示给孩子，孩子作答后用 check_answer 批改。禁止自己编题、禁止猜测或口算答案。")]
49	    public async Task<string> GeneratePractice(
50	        [Description("叶子知识点 id，如 decimal-times-decimal")] string nodeId,
51	        [Description("题目数量 1-5，默认3")] int count = 3)
52	    {
53	        if (kb.GetNode(nodeId) == null) return ToJson(new { error = $"知识点不存在: {nodeId}", tree = kb.GetTreeText() });
54	        using var scope = scopeFactory.CreateScope();
55	        var qs = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<QuestionService>();
56	        var items = await qs.GeneratePracticeAsync(nodeId, count);
57	        if (items.Count == 0) return ToJson(new { error = "该知识点暂无可用题目模板或种子题", nodeId });
58	        return ToJson(new { nodeId, count = items.Count, items });
59	    }
60	
61	    [McpServerTool(Name = "check_answer"), Description(
62	        "批改孩子对某道练习题的作答。系统自动判分、记录作答并更新掌握度与复习计划。答对或同一题尝试满3次才返回解析，否则只返回提示。你只能依据本工具结果判断对错，禁止自行判分。")]
63	    public async Task<string> CheckAnswer(
64	        [Description("generate_practice 返回的 questionId")] string questionId,
65	        [Description("孩子的答案，如 15.6 或 x=12.5")] string studentAnswer)
66	    {
67	        using var scope = scopeFactory.CreateScope();
68	        var qs = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<QuestionService>();
69	        try
70	        {
71	            var result = await qs.CheckAnswerAsync(questionId, studentAnswer);
72	            return ToJson(result);
73	        }
74	        catch (InvalidOperationException ex)
75	        {
76	            return ToJson(new { error = ex.Message });
77	        }
78	    }
79	
80	    [McpServerTool(Name = "record_wrong_question"), Description(
81	        "把孩子在学校作业、试卷、练习册上做错的题目录入错题本（外部错题）。先用 search_knowledge 或 get_knowledge_node(tree) 确定对应知识点 id。录入后系统会安排针对性复习。")]
82	    public async Task<string> RecordWrongQuestion(
83	        [Description("对应知识点 id")] string nodeId,
84	        [Description("错题原题文本")] string questionText,
85	        [Description("孩子的错误答案（可选）")] string? studentAnswer = null,
86	        [Description("正确答案（可选，仅家长/老师明确提供时才填，禁止自己编造）")] string? correctAnswer = null,
87	        [Description("备注，如错因分析（可选）")] string? note = null)
88	    {
89	        if (kb.GetNode(nodeId) == null) return ToJson(new { error = $"知识点不存在: {nodeId}", tree = kb.GetTreeText() });
90	        using var scope = scopeFactory.CreateScope();
91	        var qs = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<QuestionService>();
92	        var w = await qs.RecordWrongQuestionAsync(nodeId, questionText, studentAnswer, correctAnswer, note);
93	        return ToJson(new { recorded = true, w.Id, w.NodeId, w.Status, w.CreatedAt });
94	    }
95	
96	    [McpServerTool(Name = "list_wrong_questions"), Description(
97	        "查询错题本。默认返回未解决（Open）的错题，最多50条，按时间倒序。")]
98	    public async Task<string> ListWrongQuestions(
99	        [Description("状态过滤：Open 未解决 / Resolved 已解决，默认 Open")] string status = "Open")
100	    {
101	        using var scope = scopeFactory.CreateScope();
102	        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<EduDbContext>();
103	        var list = await db.WrongQuestions
104	            .Where(w => w.Status == status)
105	            .OrderByDescending(w => w.CreatedAt)
106	            .Take(50)
107	            .ToListAsync();
108	        return ToJson(list.Select(w => new
109	        {
110	            w.Id, w.NodeId, nodeName = kb.GetNode(w.NodeId)?.Name ?? w.NodeId,
111	            w.QuestionText, w.StudentAnswer, w.CorrectAnswer, w.Note, w.CreatedAt
112	        }));
113	    }
114	
115	    [McpServerTool(Name = "get_mastery"), Description(
116	        "查询知识点掌握度。掌握规则：连续答对3次且分布在至少2个不同日期才算掌握（Mastered）；答错会重置连对并进入1/3/7天复习梯队；掌握后30天未练习会衰减（Decayed）。nodeId 留空返回全部已跟踪知识点。")]
117	    public async Task<string> GetMastery(
118	        [Description("知识点 id，留空返回全部")] string? nodeId = null)
119	    {
120	        using var scope = scopeFactory.CreateScope();
121	        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<EduDbContext>();
122	        var now = DateTime.Now;
123	        var query = db.Masteries.AsQueryable();
124	        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(nodeId)) query = query.Where(m => m.NodeId == nodeId);
125	        var list = await query.ToListAsync();
126	        return ToJson(list.Select(m => new
127	        {
128	            m.NodeId, nodeName = kb.GetNode(m.NodeId)?.Name ?? m.NodeId,
129	            status = MasteryService.EffectiveStatus(m, now),
130	            m.StreakCorrect, m.TotalAttempts, m.CorrectAttempts, m.DistinctCorrectDays,
131	            m.LastAttemptAt, m.NextReviewAt
132	        }));
133	    }
134	
135	    [McpServerTool(Name = "get_review_due"), Description(
136	        "查询当前到期、尚未完成的复习任务（来自答错后的1/3/7天复习梯队）。辅导开始时应先查看，优先安排到期复习。")]
137	    public async Task<string> GetReviewDue()
138	    {
139	        using var scope = scopeFactory.CreateScope();
140	        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<EduDbContext>();
141	        var now = DateTime.Now;
142	        var due = await db.ReviewItems
143	            .Where(r => !r.Done && r.DueAt <= now)
144	            .OrderBy(r => r.DueAt)
145	            .ToListAsync();
146	        return ToJson(due.Select(r => new
147	        {
148	            r.Id, r.NodeId, nodeName = kb.GetNode(r.NodeId)?.Name ?? r.NodeId, r.DueAt, r.IntervalDays
149	        }));
150	    }
151	
152	    [McpServerTool(Name = "get_student_summary"), Description(
153	        "获取学生学习总览：累计作答与正确率、近7天练习量、各掌握状态知识点数量、未解决错题数、到期复习数、最近错题。生成家长报告时先调用本工具。")]
154	    public async Task<string> GetStudentSummary()
155	    {
156	        using var scope = scopeFactory.CreateScope();
157	        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<EduDbContext>();
158	        var now = DateTime.Now;
159	        var weekAgo = now.AddDays(-7);
160	
161	        var totalAttempts = await db.Attempts.CountAsync();
162	        var correctAttempts = await db.Attempts.CountAsync(a => a.IsCorrect);
163	        var weekAttempts = await db.Attempts.CountAsync(a => a.CreatedAt >= weekAgo);
164	        var weekCorrect = await db.Attempts.CountAsync(a => a.CreatedAt >= weekAgo && a.IsCorrect);
165	
166	        var masteries = await db.Masteries.ToListAsync();
167	        var statuses = masteries.Select(m => MasteryService.EffectiveStatus(m, now)).ToList();
168	        var leafCount = kb.Leaves.Count();
169	
170	        var openWrong = await db.WrongQuestions.CountAsync(w => w.Status == "Open");
171	        var dueReviews = await db.ReviewItems.CountAsync(r => !r.Done && r.DueAt <= now);
172	        var recentWrong = await db.WrongQuestions
173	            .Where(w => w.Status == "Open")
174	            .OrderByDescending(w => w.CreatedAt)
175	            .Take(5)
176	            .ToListAsync();
177	
178	        return ToJson(new
179	        {
180	            totalAttempts,
181	            correctAttempts,
182	            correctRate = totalAttempts == 0 ? 0 : Math.Round((double)correctAttempts / totalAttempts, 3),
183	            last7Days = new { attempts = weekAttempts, correct = weekCorrect },
184	            mastery = new
185	            {
186	                mastered = statuses.Count(s => s == MasteryService.Mastered),
187	                learning = statuses.Count(s => s == MasteryService.Learning),
188	                decayed = statuses.Count(s => s == MasteryService.Decayed),
189	                notStarted = leafCount - masteries.Count
190	            },
191	            openWrongQuestions = openWrong,
192	            dueReviews,
193	            recentWrongQuestions = recentWrong.Select(w => new
194	            {
195	                w.Id, nodeName = kb.GetNode(w.NodeId)?.Name ?? w.NodeId, w.QuestionText, w.CreatedAt
196	            })
197	        });
198	    }
199	}

18	public class QuestionService(EduDbContext db, QuestionGenerator generator, Mastery.MasteryService mastery)
19	{
20	    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions JsonOpts = new() { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
21	
22	    public async Task<List<PracticeItem>> GeneratePracticeAsync(string userId, string nodeId, int count)
23	    {
24	        count = Math.Clamp(count, 1, 5);
25	        var items = new List<PracticeItem>();
26	        var now = DateTime.Now;
27	
28	        for (var i = 0; i < count; i++)
29	        {
30	            var gen = generator.Generate(nodeId);
31	            if (gen == null) break;
32	            var q = new GeneratedQuestion
33	            {
34	                Id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"),
35	                UserId = userId,
36	                NodeId = nodeId,
37	                Text = gen.Text,
38	                Answer = gen.Answer,
39	                Explanation = gen.Explanation,
40	                Kind = "template",
41	                Verified = true,
42	                CreatedAt = now
43	            };
44	            db.GeneratedQuestions.Add(q);
45	            items.Add(new PracticeItem(q.Id, q.Text));
46	        }
47	
48	        if (items.Count == 0)
49	        {
50	            var seeds = LoadSeeds().Where(s => s.NodeId == nodeId).Take(count).ToList();
51	            foreach (var s in seeds)
52	            {
53	                var q = new GeneratedQuestion
54	                {
55	                    Id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"),
56	                    UserId = userId,
57	                    NodeId = s.NodeId,
58	                    Text = s.Text,
59	                    Answer = s.Answer,
60	                    Explanation = s.Explanation,
61	                    Kind = "seed",
62	                    Verified = true,
63	                    CreatedAt = now
64	                };
65	                db.GeneratedQuestions.Add(q);
66	                items.Add(new PracticeItem(q.Id, q.Text));
67	            }
68	        }
69	
70	        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
71	        return items;
72	    }
73	
74	    // 答案只存在于服务端：出题工具不返回答案，模型无法泄露
75	    public async Task<CheckResult> CheckAnswerAsync(string userId, string questionId, string studentAnswer, string source = "practice")
76	    {
77	        var q = await db.GeneratedQuestions.FindAsync(questionId)
78	                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"题目不存在: {questionId}");
79	        var now = DateTime.Now;
80	        var correct = AnswersEqual(q.Answer, studentAnswer);
81	        var priorAttempts = await db.Attempts.CountAsync(a => a.QuestionId == questionId);
82	
83	        db.Attempts.Add(new Attempt
84	        {
85	            UserId = userId,
86	            NodeId = q.NodeId,
87	            QuestionId = questionId,
88	            QuestionText = q.Text,
89	            StudentAnswer = studentAnswer,
90	            CorrectAnswer = q.Answer,
91	            IsCorrect = correct,
92	            Source = source,
93	            CreatedAt = now
94	        });
95	
96	        var m = await mastery.RecordResultAsync(userId, q.NodeId, correct, now);
97	        await mastery.MarkDueReviewsDoneAsync(userId, q.NodeId, now);
98	
99	        var attempts = priorAttempts + 1;
100	        return new CheckResult(
101	            correct,
102	            attempts,
103	            correct || attempts >= 3 ? q.Explanation : null,
104	            correct ? null : "再检查一下：小数点位置、运算顺序，或是否漏了除以 2。",
105	            m.NextReviewAt,
106	            m.Status);
107	    }
108	
109	    public async Task<WrongQuestion> RecordWrongQuestionAsync(
110	        string userId, string nodeId, string questionText, string? studentAnswer, string? correctAnswer, string? note)
111	    {
112	        var w = new WrongQuestion
113	        {
114	            UserId = userId,
115	            NodeId = nodeId,
116	            QuestionText = questionText,
117	            StudentAnswer = studentAnswer,
118	            CorrectAnswer = correctAnswer,
119	            Note = note,
120	            Status = "Open",
121	            CreatedAt = DateTime.Now
122	        };
123	        db.WrongQuestions.Add(w);
124	        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
125	        return w;
126	    }
127	
128	    public static bool AnswersEqual(string expected, string actual)
129	    {
130	        var e = Normalize(expected);
131	        var a = Normalize(actual);
132	        var ed = ParseNumeric(e);
133	        var ad = ParseNumeric(a);
134	        if (ed.HasValue && ad.HasValue)
135	            return Math.Abs(ed.Value - ad.Value) < 0.000001m;
136	        return string.Equals(e, a, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
137	    }
138	
139	    private static decimal? ParseNumeric(string s)
140	    {
141	        if (decimal.TryParse(s, out var d)) return d;
142	        var parts = s.Split('/');
143	        if (parts.Length == 2 && decimal.TryParse(parts[0], out var num) && decimal.TryParse(parts[1], out var den) && den != 0)
144	            return num / den;
145	        return null;
146	    }
147	
148	    private static string Normalize(string s) =>
149	        s.Trim().Replace(" ", "").Replace("＝", "=").TrimEnd('。', '.');
150	
151	    private record Seed(string NodeId, string Text, string Answer, string Explanation);
152	
153	    private static List<Seed> LoadSeeds()
154	    {
155	        if (!File.Exists(DataPaths.SeedsFile)) return [];
156	        return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<Seed>>(File.ReadAllText(DataPaths.SeedsFile), JsonOpts) ?? [];
157	    }
158	}

1	using EduAgent.Core.Data;

5	namespace EduAgent.Core.Mastery;
6	
7	public class MasteryService(EduDbContext db)
8	{
9	    public const string Learning = "Learning";
10	    public const string Mastered = "Mastered";
11	    public const string Decayed = "Decayed";
12	
13	    public async Task<Models.Mastery> RecordResultAsync(string userId, string nodeId, bool correct, DateTime now)
14	    {
15	        var m = await db.Masteries.FindAsync(userId, nodeId);
16	        if (m == null)
17	        {
18	            m = new Models.Mastery { UserId = userId, NodeId = nodeId };
19	            db.Masteries.Add(m);
20	        }
21	        m.TotalAttempts++;
22	        m.LastAttemptAt = now;
23	        m.UpdatedAt = now;
24	
25	        if (correct)
26	        {
27	            m.CorrectAttempts++;
28	            m.StreakCorrect++;
29	            if (m.LastCorrectDate?.Date != now.Date)
30	            {
31	                m.DistinctCorrectDays++;
32	                m.LastCorrectDate = now;
33	            }
34	            // 不同日期累计答对 3 次才算掌握，防止同一天机械刷题造成假掌握
35	            if (m.StreakCorrect >= 3 && m.DistinctCorrectDays >= 2)
36	            {
37	                m.Status = Mastered;
38	                m.NextReviewAt = now.AddDays(30);
39	            }
40	            else
41	            {
42	                m.Status = Learning;
43	                m.NextReviewAt = now.AddDays(7);
44	            }
45	        }
46	        else
47	        {
48	            m.StreakCorrect = 0;
49	            m.Status = Learning;
50	            m.NextReviewAt = now.AddDays(1);
51	            foreach (var days in new[] { 1, 3, 7 })
52	                db.ReviewItems.Add(new ReviewItem { UserId = userId, NodeId = nodeId, DueAt = now.AddDays(days), IntervalDays = days, CreatedAt = now });
53	        }
54	
55	        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
56	        return m;
57	    }
58	
59	    public static string EffectiveStatus(Models.Mastery m, DateTime now) =>
60	        m.Status == Mastered && m.LastAttemptAt < now.AddDays(-30) ? Decayed : m.Status;
61	
62	    public async Task MarkDueReviewsDoneAsync(string userId, string nodeId, DateTime now)
63	    {
64	        var due = await db.ReviewItems
65	            .Where(r => r.UserId == userId && r.NodeId == nodeId && !r.Done && r.DueAt <= now)
66	            .ToListAsync();
67	        foreach (var r in due) r.Done = true;
68	        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
69	    }
70	}

95	    // 通用桥接：MCP 工具的 JsonSchema → KernelParameterMetadata，调用时转发到 MCP Server
96	    private KernelFunction CreateBridge(McpClientTool tool)
97	    {
98	        var schema = tool.ProtocolTool.InputSchema;
99	        var required = new HashSet<string>();
100	        if (schema.TryGetProperty("required", out var reqEl) && reqEl.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
101	            foreach (var r in reqEl.EnumerateArray())
102	                if (r.GetString() is { } s) required.Add(s);
103	
104	        var parameters = new List<KernelParameterMetadata>();
105	        if (schema.TryGetProperty("properties", out var props) && props.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object)
106	        {
107	            foreach (var p in props.EnumerateObject())
108	            {
109	                parameters.Add(new KernelParameterMetadata(p.Name)
110	                {
111	                    Description = p.Value.TryGetProperty("description", out var d) ? d.GetString() ?? "" : "",
112	                    ParameterType = MapType(p.Value),
113	                    IsRequired = required.Contains(p.Name)
114	                });
115	            }
116	        }
117	
118	        return KernelFunctionFactory.CreateFromMethod(
119	            async (KernelArguments args, CancellationToken ct) =>
120	            {
121	                var callArgs = new Dictionary<string, object?>();
122	                foreach (var pm in parameters)
123	                    if (args.TryGetValue(pm.Name, out var val) && Normalize(val) is { } norm)
124	                        callArgs[pm.Name] = norm;
125	
126	                var result = await _client!.CallToolAsync(tool.Name, callArgs, cancellationToken: ct);
127	                var text = string.Join("\n", result.Content.OfType<TextContentBlock>().Select(b => b.Text));
128	                return result.IsError == true ? $"[工具错误] {text}" : text;
129	            },
130	            new KernelFunctionFromMethodOptions
131	            {
132	                FunctionName = tool.Name,
133	                Description = tool.Description ?? "",
134	                Parameters = parameters
135	            });
136	    }

155	    private static Type MapType(JsonElement propSchema)
156	    {
157	        var type = "string";
158	        if (propSchema.TryGetProperty("type", out var t))
159	        {
160	            if (t.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String) type = t.GetString() ?? "string";
161	            else if (t.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
162	                type = t.EnumerateArray().Select(x => x.GetString()).FirstOrDefault(x => x != "null") ?? "string";
163	        }
164	        return type switch
165	        {
166	            "integer" => typeof(long),
167	            "number" => typeof(double),
168	            "boolean" => typeof(bool),
169	            _ => typeof(string)
170	        };
171	    }
172	
173	    private static object? Normalize(object? v) => v switch
174	    {
175	        null => null,
176	        JsonElement je => je.ValueKind switch
177	        {
178	            JsonValueKind.String => je.GetString(),
179	            JsonValueKind.Number => je.TryGetInt64(out var l) ? l : je.GetDouble(),
180	            JsonValueKind.True => true,
181	            JsonValueKind.False => false,
182	            JsonValueKind.Null => null,
183	            _ => je.GetRawText()
184	        },
185	        _ => v
186	    };

188	    public async IAsyncEnumerable<string> ChatStreamAsync(
189	        string sessionId, string userMessage, [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken ct = default)
190	    {
191	        if (_kernel == null)
192	        {
193	            yield return Sse(new { type = "error", message = "尚未配置大模型 API Key。请在 appsettings.json 的 Llm.ApiKey 填入 DeepSeek（或其他 OpenAI 兼容服务）密钥后重启。工具自检 /api/selftest 无需 Key 即可运行。" });
194	            yield break;
195	        }
196	
197	        var history = _sessions.GetOrAdd(sessionId, _ =>
198	        {
199	            var h = new ChatHistory();
200	            h.AddSystemMessage(_systemPrompt);
201	            return h;
202	        });
203	        history.AddUserMessage(userMessage);
204	
205	        var settings = new OpenAIPromptExecutionSettings
206	        {
207	            ToolCallBehavior = ToolCallBehavior.AutoInvokeKernelFunctions,
208	            Temperature = 0.4
209	        };
210	        var chat = _kernel.GetRequiredService<IChatCompletionService>();
211	        var full = new StringBuilder();
212	        var seenCalls = new HashSet<string>();
213	
214	        await foreach (var chunk in chat.GetStreamingChatMessageContentsAsync(history, settings, _kernel, ct))
215	        {
216	            foreach (var item in chunk.Items)
217	                if (item is StreamingFunctionCallUpdateContent fc
218	                    && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(fc.Name)
219	                    && fc.CallId is { } callId
220	                    && seenCalls.Add(callId))
221	                    yield return Sse(new { type = "tool", name = fc.Name });
222	
223	            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(chunk.Content))
224	            {
225	                full.Append(chunk.Content);
226	                yield return Sse(new { type = "delta", text = chunk.Content });
227	            }
228	        }
229	
230	        if (full.Length > 0) history.AddAssistantMessage(full.ToString());
231	        TrimHistory(history);
232	        yield return Sse(new { type = "done" });
233	    }

76	      <button data-q="帮我看看哪些知识点需要复习">今日复习</button>

81	      <textarea id="input" rows="1" placeholder="和小智老师说说，今天想学什么、练什么，或把错题告诉它…"></textarea>

83	    </div>
84	  </div>
85	  <div id="side">
86	    <div id="tabs">
87	      <button data-tab="summary" class="active">总览</button>
88	      <button data-tab="mastery">掌握度</button>
89	      <button data-tab="wrong">错题本</button>
90	      <button data-tab="review">复习</button>
91	      <button data-tab="selftest">自检</button>
92	    </div>
93	    <div id="sideBody"></div>
94	  </div>
95	</main>
96	<script>
97	const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
98	const msgs=$('#messages'), input=$('#input'), send=$('#send'), sideBody=$('#sideBody');
99	const sessionId='web-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10);
100	let busy=false;
101	
102	function esc(s){return (s||'').replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));}
103	function fmt(s){return esc(s).replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g,'<b>$1</b>').replace(/\n/g,'<br>');}
104	function addMsg(cls,html){const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='msg '+cls;d.innerHTML=html;msgs.appendChild(d);msgs.scrollTop=msgs.scrollHeight;return d;}
105	function addTools(){const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='tools';msgs.appendChild(d);return d;}
106	function addChip(box,name){const c=document.createElement('span');c.className='chip';c.innerHTML='🔧 <b>'+esc(name)+'</b>';box.appendChild(c);msgs.scrollTop=msgs.scrollHeight;}
107	
108	async function loadStatus(){
109	  try{
110	    const r=await fetch('/api/status');const j=await r.json();
111	    const el=$('#status');
112	    if(j.llmConfigured){el.classList.add('on');$('#statusText').textContent='大模型已连接 · '+j.toolCount+' 个工具';}
113	    else{$('#statusText').textContent='未配置大模型 Key（自检可用）';}
114	  }catch(e){$('#statusText').textContent='服务未就绪';}
115	}
116	
117	async function sendMessage(text){
118	  if(busy||!text.trim())return;
119	  busy=true;send.disabled=true;
120	  addMsg('user',esc(text));
121	  input.value='';input.style.height='auto';
122	  const toolBox=addTools();
123	  const bot=addMsg('bot','');
124	  let acc='';
125	  try{
126	    const resp=await fetch('/api/chat',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({sessionId,message:text})});
127	    const reader=resp.body.getReader();const dec=new TextDecoder();let buf='';
128	    while(true){
129	      const {done,value}=await reader.read();if(done)break;
130	      buf+=dec.decode(value,{stream:true});
131	      const parts=buf.split('\n\n');buf=parts.pop();
132	      for(const p of parts){
133	        const line=p.trim();if(!line.startsWith('data:'))continue;
134	        let ev;try{ev=JSON.parse(line.slice(5).trim());}catch{continue;}
135	        if(ev.type==='tool'){addChip(toolBox,ev.name);}
136	        else if(ev.type==='delta'){acc+=ev.text;bot.innerHTML=fmt(acc);msgs.scrollTop=msgs.scrollHeight;}
137	        else if(ev.type==='error'){bot.innerHTML='<span style="color:#d64545">'+esc(ev.message)+'</span>';}
138	      }
139	    }
140	    if(!acc&&!bot.innerHTML)bot.innerHTML='<span style="color:var(--sub)">（无回复）</span>';
141	    if(toolBox.childElementCount===0)toolBox.remove();
142	  }catch(e){bot.innerHTML='<span style="color:#d64545">请求失败：'+esc(e.message)+'</span>';}
143	  busy=false;send.disabled=false;input.focus();
144	  refreshSide();
145	}
146	
147	send.onclick=()=>sendMessage(input.value);
148	input.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'&&!e.shiftKey){e.preventDefault();sendMessage(input.value);}});
149	input.addEventListener('input',()=>{input.style.height='auto';input.style.height=Math.min(input.scrollHeight,120)+'px';});
150	document.querySelectorAll('.quick button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>sendMessage(b.dataset.q));
151	
152	// ---- sidebar ----
153	let currentTab='summary';
154	const statusZh={Learning:'学习中',Mastered:'已掌握',Decayed:'已衰减'};
155	async function getJson(url){const r=await fetch(url);return r.json();}
156	
157	function renderSummary(j){
158	  const m=j.mastery||{};
159	  return `<div class="card"><h4>练习概况</h4>
160	    <div class="stat"><span>累计作答</span><b>${j.totalAttempts||0}</b></div>
161	    <div class="stat"><span>答对</span><b>${j.correctAttempts||0}</b></div>
162	    <div class="stat"><span>正确率</span><b>${Math.round((j.correctRate||0)*100)}%</b></div>
163	    <div class="stat"><span>近7天练习</span><b>${(j.last7Days&&j.last7Days.attempts)||0}</b></div>
164	  </div>
165	  <div class="card"><h4>知识点掌握（共13个）</h4>
166	    <div class="stat"><span>已掌握</span><b style="color:var(--ok)">${m.mastered||0}</b></div>
167	    <div class="stat"><span>学习中</span><b style="color:var(--warn)">${m.learning||0}</b></div>
168	    <div class="stat"><span>已衰减</span><b style="color:#d64545">${m.decayed||0}</b></div>
169	    <div class="stat"><span>未开始</span><b>${m.notStarted||0}</b></div>
170	  </div>
171	  <div class="card"><h4>待办</h4>
172	    <div class="stat"><span>未解决错题</span><b>${j.openWrongQuestions||0}</b></div>
173	    <div class="stat"><span>到期复习</span><b>${j.dueReviews||0}</b></div>
174	  </div>`;
175	}
176	function renderMastery(arr){
177	  if(!arr||!arr.length)return '<div class="empty">还没有练习记录。<br>先在左侧出题练习，掌握度会自动更新。</div>';
178	  return arr.map(m=>`<div class="card"><h4>${esc(m.nodeName)}<span class="badge b-${m.status}">${statusZh[m.status]||m.status}</span></h4>
179	    <div class="meta">连对 ${m.streakCorrect} · 总作答 ${m.totalAttempts} · 答对 ${m.correctAttempts} · 不同日答对 ${m.distinctCorrectDays}</div>
180	    ${m.nextReviewAt?'<div class="meta">下次复习：'+new Date(m.nextReviewAt).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN')+'</div>':''}
181	  </div>`).join('');
182	}
183	function renderWrong(arr){
184	  if(!arr||!arr.length)return '<div class="empty">错题本是空的。<br>把孩子作业/试卷上的错题告诉小智老师，会自动录入。</div>';
185	  return arr.map(w=>`<div class="card"><h4>${esc(w.nodeName)}</h4>
186	    <div>${esc(w.questionText)}</div>
187	    <div class="meta">孩子答案：${esc(w.studentAnswer||'—')}${w.correctAnswer?' · 正确：'+esc(w.correctAnswer):''}</div>
188	    ${w.note?'<div class="meta">备注：'+esc(w.note)+'</div>':''}
189	    <div class="meta">${new Date(w.createdAt).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}</div>
190	  </div>`).join('');
191	}
192	function renderReview(arr){
193	  if(!arr||!arr.length)return '<div class="empty">当前没有到期复习。<br>答错的知识点会进入 1/3/7 天复习梯队。</div>';
194	  return arr.map(r=>`<div class="card"><h4>${esc(r.nodeName)}</h4>
195	    <div class="meta">间隔 ${r.intervalDays} 天 · 到期 ${new Date(r.dueAt).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}</div>
196	  </div>`).join('');
197	}
198	function renderSelftest(j){
199	  let h=`<button id="selftestBtn">运行全链路自检（无需大模型 Key）</button>
200	  <div class="hint">直接经 MCP 协议调用全部 ${j.toolCount||''} 个教育工具，验证 知识库/RAG/出题/批改/掌握度/错题/复习 闭环。大模型状态：${j.llmConfigured?'已配置':'未配置 Key'}。</div>`;
201	  if(j.steps){
202	    h+=j.steps.map(s=>`<details class="step"><summary>${esc(s.step)}</summary><pre>${esc(JSON.stringify(s.result,null,2))}</pre></details>`).join('');
203	  }
204	  return h;
205	}
206	
207	let selftestCache=null;
208	async function refreshSide(){
209	  const tab=currentTab;
210	  if(tab==='selftest'){
211	    if(selftestCache){sideBody.innerHTML=renderSelftest(selftestCache);bindSelftest();}
212	    else{sideBody.innerHTML=renderSelftest({});bindSelftest();}
213	    return;
214	  }
215	  sideBody.innerHTML='<div class="empty">加载中…</div>';
216	  try{
217	    if(tab==='summary')sideBody.innerHTML=renderSummary(await getJson('/api/summary'));
218	    else if(tab==='mastery')sideBody.innerHTML=renderMastery(await getJson('/api/mastery'));
219	    else if(tab==='wrong')sideBody.innerHTML=renderWrong(await getJson('/api/wrong-questions'));
220	    else if(tab==='review')sideBody.innerHTML=renderReview(await getJson('/api/review-due'));
221	  }catch(e){sideBody.innerHTML='<div class="empty">加载失败：'+esc(e.message)+'</div>';}
222	}
223	function bindSelftest(){
224	  const b=$('#selftestBtn');if(!b)return;
225	  b.onclick=async()=>{
226	    b.disabled=true;b.textContent='自检运行中…';
227	    try{selftestCache=await getJson('/api/selftest');sideBody.innerHTML=renderSelftest(selftestCache);bindSelftest();refreshSide();}
228	    catch(e){b.textContent='自检失败：'+e.message;b.disabled=false;}
229	  };
230	}
231	document.querySelectorAll('#tabs button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
232	  document.querySelectorAll('#tabs button').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));
233	  b.classList.add('active');currentTab=b.dataset.tab;refreshSide();
234	});
235	
236	addMsg('sys','你好，我是小智老师 👋 可以帮你讲解知识点、出针对性练习、批改作答、记录错题，还会安排复习。先试试右下角的快捷按钮，或直接告诉我今天想练什么。');
237	loadStatus();refreshSide();
238	</script>
239	</body>
240	</html>

32	    {

11	
12	        var dir = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);

16	                File.Exists(Path.Combine(dir.FullName, "EduAgent.sln")))
17	                return Path.Combine(dir.FullName, "data");
18	            dir = dir.Parent;
19	        }
20	        return Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "data");
21	    }

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

var builder = Host.CreateApplicationBuilder(args);

phone) => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(phone) && PhoneRegex.IsMatch(phone);\n\n    // Mock 短信：不真正下发，固定验证码 123456。仅校验手机号格式。\n    public Task<bool> SendCodeAsync(string phone) => Task.FromResult(IsValidPhone(phone));\n\n    public async Task<LoginResult?> LoginAsync(string phone, string code)\n    {\n        if (!IsValidPhone(phone) || code != MockCode) return null;\n\n        var user = await db.Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Phone == phone);\n        var isNew = user == null;\n        if (user == null)\n        {\n            user = new User\n            {\n                Id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(\"N\"),\n                Phone = phone,\n                NickName = \"同学\" + phone[^4..],\n                CreatedAt = DateTime.Now\n            };\n            db.Users.Add(user);\n            await db.SaveChangesAsync();\n        }\n\n        return new LoginResult(IssueToken(user), user.Id, user.Phone, user.NickName, isNew);\n    }\n\n    public async Task<User?> GetUserAsync(string userId) => await db.Users.FindAsync(userId);\n\n    private string IssueToken(User user)\n    {\n        var claims = new[]\n        {\n            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub, user.Id),\n            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Jti, Guid.NewGuid().ToString(\"N\")),\n            new Claim(\"phone\", user.Phone),\n            new Claim(\"nickname\", user.NickName)\n        };\n        var token = new JwtSecurityToken(\n            issuer: jwt.Issuer,\n            audience: jwt.Audience,\n            claims: claims,\n            expires: DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(jwt.ExpireDays),\n            signingCredentials: new SigningCredentials(signingKey, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256));\n        return new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(token);\n    }\n}",

61	        var transport = new StdioClientTransport(new StdioClientTransportOptions
62	        {
63	            // Windows 下 SDK 用 cmd.exe /c 包装：Command 必须无空格（经 PATH 解析），
64	            // 含空格的项目路径放在 Arguments 里由 ArgumentList 自动加引号
65	            Command = "dotnet",

98	    // 通用桥接：MCP 工具的 JsonSchema → KernelParameterMetadata，调用时转发到 MCP Server
99	    private KernelFunction CreateBridge(McpClientTool tool)
100	    {
101	        var schema = tool.ProtocolTool.InputSchema;
102	        var required = new HashSet<string>();
103	        if (schema.TryGetProperty("required", out var reqEl) && reqEl.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
104	            foreach (var r in reqEl.EnumerateArray())
105	                if (r.GetString() is { } s) required.Add(s);
106	
107	        var parameters = new List<KernelParameterMetadata>();
108	        if (schema.TryGetProperty("properties", out var props) && props.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object)
109	        {
110	            foreach (var p in props.EnumerateObject())
111	            {
112	                parameters.Add(new KernelParameterMetadata(p.Name)
113	                {
114	                    Description = p.Value.TryGetProperty("description", out var d) ? d.GetString() ?? "" : "",
115	                    ParameterType = MapType(p.Value),
116	                    IsRequired = required.Contains(p.Name)
117	                });
118	            }
119	        }
120	
121	        return KernelFunctionFactory.CreateFromMethod(
122	            async (KernelArguments args, CancellationToken ct) =>
123	            {
124	                var callArgs = new Dictionary<string, object?>();
125	                foreach (var pm in parameters)
126	                    if (args.TryGetValue(pm.Name, out var val) && Normalize(val) is { } norm)
127	                        callArgs[pm.Name] = norm;

### **Assistant**

You chose persisting chat history. Right now the conversation lives only in memory (`_sessions`), so it vanishes on restart and the agent loses context. I'll persist messages per user, restore them on login, and expose them via a tool/API. Let me first confirm the current entity and service state.

## 做了什么

## 做了什么
- **新实体 `ChatMessage`**（UserId / SessionId / Role / Content / CreatedAt），按 `(UserId, SessionId, CreatedAt)` 建索引。[Entities.cs](file:///D:/【智慧教育】/【教育 Agent】/src/EduAgent.Core/Models/Entities.cs)
- **幂等建表**：[EduDbContext.cs](file:///D:/【智慧教育】/【教育 Agent】/src/EduAgent.Core/Data/EduDbContext.cs) 的 `DbInitializer` 用 `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` 补建新表——**这次没重置库**，现有数据不受影响。
- **持久化 + 恢复**：[McpAgentService.cs](file:///D:/【智慧教育】/【教育 Agent】/src/EduAgent.Web/McpAgentService.cs) 每轮把 user/assistant 消息写库；会话首次创建时从 DB 恢复 SK 上下文（取最近 40 条），所以重启后智能体仍记得聊过什么。
- **新工具 `list_chat_history`**（现共 11 个工具）+ `/api/chat-history` 端点。
- **前端**：[index.html](file:///D:/【智慧教育】/【教育 Agent】/src/EduAgent.Web/wwwroot/index.html) 改用稳定会话 id `main`，登录时把历史对话渲染回聊天面板。

### **Assistant**

**不要放进 wwwroot。** wwwroot 是静态资源目录，里面的任何文件都能通过 URL 直接下载——把 data 放进去意味着 `eduagent.db`（全部用户的错题、聊天记录）、向量库、教学文档全部对外暴露。data 是运行时数据，必须放在 wwwroot 之外。

**推荐放法**（[DataPaths.cs:10](file:///D:/【智慧教育】/【教育 Agent】/src/EduAgent.Core/DataPaths.cs#L10) 的解析优先级）：

1. 设环境变量 `EDU_DATA_DIR` 指向站点外的绝对路径，例如 `D:\EduData`，把整个 data 文件夹拷过去。IIS 里在发布生成的 web.config 的 `<aspNetCore>` 节点下加：
   ```xml
   <environmentVariables>
     <environmentVariable name="EDU_DATA_DIR" value="D:\EduData" />
   </environmentVariables>
   ```
2. 给应用池身份 `IIS AppPool\<你的应用池名>` 对该目录的**修改**权限（SQLite WAL 模式要写 `-wal`/`-shm` 文件，只读会报错）。

不设这个变量也能跑：发布后没有 .slnx，代码会回退到 `<站点物理路径>\data`，即与 wwwroot **同级**的 data 文件夹。但站点目录权限通常收紧、重新发布时容易误删，不如独立目录干净。

**拷贝内容**：`knowledge/`、`knowledge-tree.json`、`skills/`、`seeds/`、`models/`（ONNX 模型必带，否则本地向量化失效、检索退化为关键词匹配）。`eduagent.db` 和 `vectors.json` 是运行时自动生成的（向量索引首次检索时增量构建），想保留现有数据就一起拷。

**一个必须提醒的坑**：当前代码直接 publish 到 IIS 会启动失败。[McpAgentService.cs:59](file:///D:/【智慧教育】/【教育 Agent】/src/EduAgent.Web/McpAgentService.cs#L59) 靠 `BaseDirectory.Replace("EduAgent.Web", "EduAgent.McpServer")` 找 MCP 子进程——发布目录名不含 "EduAgent.Web"，替换失效，会抛"找不到 MCP Server 程序集"；而且 IIS 应用池的 PATH 里也不一定有 `dotnet` 命令。这正是之前标记的 IIS 部署前置改造项。

This is a question about the architecture of DataPaths.cs and IIS deployment. Let me think about what I know:

From DataPaths.cs:
```csharp
public static string Root { get; } = Resolve();

private static string Resolve()
{
    var env = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("EDU_DATA_DIR");
    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(env)) return Path.GetFullPath(env);

    var dir = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);
    while (dir != null)
    {
        if (File.Exists(Path.Combine(dir.FullName, "EduAgent.slnx")) ||
            File.Exists(Path.Combine(dir.FullName, "EduAgent.sln")))
            return Path.Combine(dir.FullName, "data");
        dir = dir.Parent;
    }
    return Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "data");
}
```

So the data directory resolution is:
1. If the environment variable `EDU_DATA_DIR` is set, use it.
2. Otherwise, walk up from AppContext.BaseDirectory looking for a solution file (EduAgent.slnx or EduAgent.sln). If found, use `<solution root>/data`.
3. Fallback: `<AppContext.BaseDirectory>/data`.

In an IIS deployment scenario:
- The published output doesn't contain a solution file, so it falls back to `AppContext.BaseDirectory/data` — i.e., the data folder ends up sitting inside the published site directory (e.g., `C:\inetpub\wwwroot\eduagent\data` or wherever the site's physical path is).
- wwwroot is the static files directory. The data folder should NOT go inside wwwroot. Reasons:
  1. wwwroot is served as static files by ASP.NET Core — putting data there would expose the SQLite DB, vectors.json, knowledge files, etc. to direct HTTP download. Security issue!
  2. The data folder is runtime data (DB, generated vectors), not static web assets.

So the answer is: No, don't put it in wwwroot. Options:
- Put it at the site root (next to wwwroot, e.g., `site\data`) — this is the fallback behavior of DataPaths when no solution file is found. But wait — in IIS, AppContext.BaseDirectory is the site's physical path. So the fallback would be `<site physical path>\data`. That works, but the site directory might be read-only for the app pool identity? Actually the app pool needs write permission there.
- Better: set the `EDU_DATA_DIR` environment variable to an absolute path outside the site (e.g., `D:\EduData`), and grant the IIS app pool identity (IIS AppPool\<AppPoolName>) modify permissions.

Also, there are important caveats I flagged earlier: the MCP child process spawning architecture (`AppContext.BaseDirectory.Replace("EduAgent.Web","EduAgent.McpServer")`) breaks under dotnet publish/IIS. 1. **No, don't put it in wwwroot.** wwwroot is the static resource directory, and anything inside it is directly accessible via HTTP — putting the SQLite database, vectors, and knowledge base there means anyone could download eduagent.db via a URL (all user data leaks). Also, data is runtime data, not static assets.

In IIS, this can be set via `<environmentVariables>` in web.config. Grant the app pool identity (IIS AppPool\xxx) modify permissions on that folder (the DB needs write access).

3. **What to copy:** the entire data folder including models/ (ONNX), knowledge/, skills/, seeds/. The DB and vectors are runtime-generated, but copying the existing ones preserves data.

Confirmed: vectors.json is auto-built on the first search if it doesn't exist (incremental, hash-based). DB is auto-created via EnsureCreated + seed. Therefore, the only things that need to be copied are the content files (knowledge/, knowledge-tree.json, skills/, seeds/, models/), and the runtime files (eduagent.db, vectors.json) are optional (copy them if you want to preserve data).

Now let me structure the response. Key points:

1. **Don't put it in wwwroot** — wwwroot is the static resource directory, and anything inside it can be downloaded directly via URL: eduagent.db (all users' data), vectors.json, teaching materials would all be exposed. data is runtime data and must be placed outside wwwroot.

2. **Recommended approach**: Set the environment variable `EDU_DATA_DIR` to an absolute path outside the site (e.g., `D:\EduData`), and copy the entire data folder there. DataPaths.cs:10-12 reads this variable with highest priority.
   - How to set it in IIS: add `<environmentVariables>` under `<aspNetCore>` in web.config (publish generates web.config, so edit it after publishing), or set a machine-level environment variable and restart the app pool.
   - Permissions: grant the app pool identity `IIS AppPool\<app pool name>` "Modify" permission on that directory (SQLite WAL needs to write -wal/-shm files).

3. **What happens if you don't set it**: after publish there's no .slnx, so DataPaths falls back to `<site physical path>\data` — that is, a data folder at the same level as wwwroot (not inside it). This also works, but the site directory usually has tight permissions, and it's easy to accidentally delete during redeploy, so it's not recommended.

4. **What to copy**: knowledge/, knowledge-tree.json, skills/, seeds/, models/ (ONNX model, required, otherwise local embedding is disabled and it falls back to keyword search). eduagent.db / vectors.json are auto-generated at runtime (the vector index is incrementally built on the first search); copy them together if you want to preserve existing data.

5. **Important heads-up (honestly)**: the current code will fail to start if you publish directly to IIS — McpAgentService.cs:59 uses `AppContext.BaseDirectory.Replace("EduAgent.Web","EduAgent.McpServer")` to find the MCP child process, but the publish directory name doesn't contain "EduAgent.Web", so it can't find EduAgent.McpServer.dll; furthermore, the IIS app pool's PATH doesn't necessarily have dotnet. ## 部署步骤（管理员 PowerShell）

**1. 安装 IIS**
```powershell
Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -NoRestart -All -FeatureName IIS-WebServerRole, IIS-WebServer, IIS-CommonHttpFeatures, IIS-StaticContent, IIS-DefaultDocument, IIS-HttpErrors, IIS-ApplicationDevelopment, IIS-ISAPIExtensions, IIS-ISAPIFilter, IIS-WebServerManagementTools, IIS-ManagementConsole
```

**2. 安装 .NET 10 Hosting Bundle（必须在 IIS 之后装）**
```powershell
winget install --id Microsoft.DotNet.HostingBundle.10 -e --source winget
iisreset
```

**3. IIS 管理器建站**
- 应用程序池 → 添加：名称 `EduAgent`，**.NET CLR 版本 = 无托管代码**
- 网站 → 添加：名称 `EduAgent`，应用池选 `EduAgent`，物理路径 `D:\【智慧教育】\【教育 Agent】\publish`，端口 `8080`（避开占用）

**4. 授权（关键，SQLite 需要写权限）**
```powershell
icacls "D:\EduData" /grant "IIS AppPool\EduAgent":(OI)(CI)M /T
icacls "D:\【智慧教育】\【教育 Agent】\publish" /grant "IIS AppPool\EduAgent":(OI)(CI)RX /T
```

**5. 验证**：浏览器开 `http://localhost:8080/api/status` 应返回 11 个工具；首页用任意手机号 + 验证码 `123456` 登录。

Stream adapter:
```csharp
internal sealed class PipeStream(PipeWriter writer, PipeReader reader) : Stream
{
    public override bool CanRead => true;
    public override bool CanWrite => true;
    public override bool CanSeek => false;
    public override long Length => throw new NotSupportedException();
    public override long Position { get => throw new NotSupportedException(); set => throw new NotSupportedException(); }
    public override void Flush() { }
    public override Task FlushAsync(CancellationToken ct) => Task.CompletedTask;
    public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) => ReadAsync(buffer, offset, count).AsTask().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
    public override async ValueTask<int> ReadAsync(Memory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var result = await reader.ReadAsync(ct);
        var seq = result.Buffer;
        var len = (int)Math.Min(seq.Length, buffer.Length);
        seq.Slice(0, len).CopyTo(buffer.Span);
        reader.AdvanceTo(seq.GetPosition(len));
        return len;
    }
    public override async ValueTask WriteAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var flush = await writer.WriteAsync(buffer, ct);
        // flushResult
    }
    ...
}
```

Hmm, wait — there's a subtle point with ReadAsync: if result.IsCompleted and the buffer is empty, return 0. Also, AdvanceTo(consumed, examined) — if we only consume part of it, we should examine the entire buffer so that ReadAsync doesn't return the same data again without waiting. The standard pattern:

```csharp
var result = await reader.ReadAsync(ct);
var buffer = result.Buffer;
if (buffer.Length == 0 && result.IsCompleted) return 0;
var len = (int)Math.Min(buffer.Length, destination.Length);
buffer.Slice(0, len).CopyTo(destination.Span);
reader.AdvanceTo(buffer.GetPosition(len), buffer.End);
return len;
```

By examining buffer.End, we tell the pipe "I've looked at everything up to the end. Don't wake me up until there's more data than this." This is correct.

WriteAsync: `await writer.WriteAsync(buffer, ct)` returns a FlushResult. If IsCompleted, throw. Should we flush on every write? PipeWriter.WriteAsync automatically flushes when the buffer exceeds the threshold, but for message-based protocols, each JSON-RPC message write should be flushed so the reader can receive it promptly. The transport probably writes a complete message and then flushes the stream. To be safe, flush after each WriteAsync: `await writer.FlushAsync(ct)`. This guarantees delivery. Performance is fine for this use case.

Also, override the async methods for Read(byte[],...)/Write(byte[],...) — the base Stream's ReadAsync(byte[]) delegates to ReadAsync(Memory) — actually, the base Stream.ReadAsync(byte[], int, int, ct) calls ReadAsync(Memory<byte>, ct), which by default wraps the sync Read. Since we override the Memory version, we're fine. The sync Read/Write can be implemented via the async versions (the transport uses async).

Dispose: complete the writer and reader: `writer.Complete(); reader.Complete();`.

Key findings:

1. **Timing issue confirmed**: `Program.cs:55-56` calls `agent.StartAsync()` after `app.Build()` but before `app.Run()`. If the MCP server runs as a hosted service inside Web's host, it hasn't started yet at the point StartAsync runs. The client's `initialize` request gets written into the pipe and blocks waiting for a response → **deadlock** (the server only starts reading once app.Run() kicks off the hosted services, but we never reach app.Run()).

   Solutions:
   a. Move `agent.StartAsync()` into a hosted service registered after the MCP server's hosted service. Hosted services start in registration order. AddMcpServer registers its hosted service at the point it's called (line ~23 area). If we register a `McpAgentStartupHostedService` after that, ordering is guaranteed.
   b. Don't await the full connection in StartAsync before Run — e.g., fire-and-forget with retry. Ugly.
   c. Manually start the MCP server before the client connects — i.e., design A (a separate host run in the background). No ordering issue.
   d. Lazily connect the client on first use. More changes.

   Option (a) is clean: create a small `IHostedService` that calls `agent.StartAsync()` in StartAsync. Register it after AddMcpServer. Then remove the direct call in Program.cs. Web's host starts hosted services in order: first the MCP server's hosted service (starts the read loop), then ours (client connects).

   Wait — does the MCP server's hosted service's StartAsync block until the server is fully running, or does it spin up a background loop and return? Typically it kicks off a background task and returns. Either way, once it returns, the read loop is active (or about to be). Even if there's a slight race, the pipe buffers the client's initialize bytes, so the server will read them whenever it starts. No deadlock as long as the server's hosted service StartAsync doesn't wait for a client. It doesn't — the server just listens.

   Actually, even simpler: since the pipe buffers, ordering barely matters — as long as the server eventually starts. The only deadlock risk is awaiting the client connection before the host runs the server's hosted service. With (a), both run during app.RunAsync's startup, in order.

   ```csharp
   using System.IO.Pipelines;
   using ModelContextProtocol.Client;
   using ModelContextProtocol.Protocol;

   namespace EduAgent.Web;

   // In-process MCP channel: two memory pipes form a full-duplex link,
   // server and client each hold one end, replacing the stdio child process (IIS in-process hosting has no child processes)
   public sealed class InProcessMcpLink : IDisposable
   {
       private readonly Pipe _clientToServer = new();
       private readonly Pipe _serverToClient = new();

       public Stream ServerInput { get; }
       public Stream ServerOutput { get; }
       public Stream ClientWrite { get; }
       public Stream ClientRead { get; }

       public InProcessMcpLink()
       {
           ServerInput = new PipeStream(_clientToServer.Reader);
           ServerOutput = new PipeStream(_serverToClient.Writer);
           ClientWrite = new PipeStream(_clientToServer.Writer);
           ClientRead = new PipeStream(_serverToClient.Reader);
       }

       public void Dispose()
       {
           _clientToServer.Reader.Complete();
           _clientToServer.Writer.Complete();
           _serverToClient.Reader.Complete();
           _serverToClient.Writer.Complete();
       }
   }
   ```

   Hmm, wait — should the link own the StreamClientTransport creation? Keep the link transport-agnostic (just streams); McpAgentService builds StreamClientTransport. Good separation.

   PipeStream:
   ```csharp
   internal sealed class PipeStream : Stream
   {
       private readonly PipeReader? _reader;
       private readonly PipeWriter? _writer;

       public PipeStream(PipeReader reader) => _reader = reader;
       public PipeStream(PipeWriter writer) => _writer = writer;

       public override bool CanRead => _reader != null;
       public override bool CanWrite => _writer != null;
       public override bool CanSeek => false;
       public override long Length => throw new NotSupportedException();
       public override long Position { get => throw new NotSupportedException(); set => throw new NotSupportedException(); }
       public override void Flush() { }
       public override Task FlushAsync(CancellationToken ct) => Task.CompletedTask;
       public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin) => throw new NotSupportedException();
       public override void SetLength(long value) => throw new NotSupportedException();

       public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) =>
           ReadAsync(buffer.AsMemory(offset, count)).AsTask().GetAwaiter().GetResult();

       public override async ValueTask<int> ReadAsync(Memory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken ct = default)
       {
           var result = await _reader!.ReadAsync(ct);
           var seq = result.Buffer;
           if (seq.IsEmpty && result.IsCompleted) return 0;
           var len = (int)Math.Min(seq.Length, buffer.Length);
           seq.Slice(0, len).CopyTo(buffer.Span);
           _reader.AdvanceTo(seq.GetPosition(len), seq.End);
           return len;
       }

       public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) =>
           WriteAsync(buffer.AsMemory(offset, count)).AsTask().GetAwaiter().GetResult();

       public override async ValueTask WriteAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken ct = default)
       {
           var flush = await _writer!.WriteAsync(buffer, ct);
           if (flush.IsCompleted) throw new IOException("MCP in-process pipe has been closed");
       }

       protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
       {
           // The link uniformly Completes both ends; here we only mark the stream as disposed
           base.Dispose(disposing);
       }
   }
   ```

   Wait, PipeWriter.WriteAsync flushes automatically (returns FlushResult). Explicit FlushAsync not needed — WriteAsync flushes. Good.

   One concern: `ReadAsync` when seq.Length > buffer.Length: consume len, examine seq.End — correct, the remainder stays buffered.

   Another: StreamClientTransport might call synchronous Read/Write? It's an async SDK; probably uses ReadAsync. Sync overrides provided just in case.

   Also, the transport might check CanSeek/Length? Unlikely for a stream transport.

  "content": "using System.IO.Pipelines;\n\nnamespace EduAgent.Web;\n\n// 进程内 MCP 通道：两条内存管道构成全双工链路，服务端/客户端各持一端，\n// 替代 stdio 子进程（IIS inprocess 托管下不依赖 dotnet 命令与平行输出目录）\npublic sealed class InProcessMcpLink : IDisposable\n{\n    private readonly Pipe _clientToServer = new();\n    private readonly Pipe _serverToClient = new();\n\n    public Stream ServerInput { get; }\n    public Stream ServerOutput { get; }\n    public Stream ClientWrite { get; }\n    public Stream ClientRead { get; }\n\n    public InProcessMcpLink()\n    {\n        ServerInput = new PipeStream(_clientToServer.Reader);\n        ServerOutput = new PipeStream(_serverToClient.Writer);\n        ClientWrite = new PipeStream(_clientToServer.Writer);\n        ClientRead = new PipeStream(_serverToClient.Reader);\n    }\n\n    public void Dispose()\n    {\n        _clientToServer.Reader.Complete();\n        _clientToServer.Writer.Complete();\n        _serverToClient.Reader.Complete();\n        _serverToClient.Writer.Complete();\n    }\n}\n\ninternal sealed class PipeStream : Stream\n{\n    private readonly PipeReader? _reader;\n    private readonly PipeWriter? _writer;\n\n    public PipeStream(PipeReader reader) => _reader = reader;\n    public PipeStream(PipeWriter writer) => _writer = writer;\n\n    public override bool CanRead => _reader != null;\n    public override bool CanWrite => _writer != null;\n    public override bool CanSeek => false;\n    public override long Length => throw new NotSupportedException();\n    public override long Position { get => throw new NotSupportedException(); set => throw new NotSupportedException(); }\n    public override void Flush() { }\n    public override Task FlushAsync(CancellationToken ct) => Task.CompletedTask;\n    public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin) => throw new NotSupportedException();\n    public override void SetLength(long value) => throw new NotSupportedException();\n\n    public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) =>\n        ReadAsync(buffer.AsMemory(offset, count)).AsTask().GetAwaiter().GetResult();\n\n    public override async ValueTask<int> ReadAsync(Memory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken ct = default)\n    {\n        var result = await _reader!.ReadAsync(ct);\n        var seq = result.Buffer;\n        if (seq.IsEmpty && result.IsCompleted) return 0;\n        var len = (int)Math.Min(seq.Length, buffer.Length);\n        seq.Slice(0, len).CopyTo(buffer.Span);\n        _reader.AdvanceTo(seq.GetPosition(len), seq.End);\n        return len;\n    }\n\n    public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) =>\n        WriteAsync(buffer.AsMemory(offset, count)).AsTask().GetAwaiter().GetResult();\n\n    public override async ValueTask WriteAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken ct = default)\n    {\n        var flush = await _writer!.WriteAsync(buffer, ct);\n        if (flush.IsCompleted) throw new IOException(\"进程内 MCP 管道已关闭\");\n    }\n}",

Now the bug is clearly visible:

```
[pipe] write len=9784        ← server writes tools/list response (9784 bytes)
[pipe] write done completed=False
[pipe] read got=9784 completed=False   ← client reads... but wait

[pipe] read got=8761 completed=False   ← only 8761 out of 9784!!
[pipe] read wait cap=1024    ← stuck waiting for more
```

The client's read buffer is 1024 bytes (cap=1024). The first read after the 9784-byte write returned... let me re-read the trace:

1. `write len=9784` — server writes the entire response into the pipe.
2. `read got=9784` — hmm, this says the reader saw 9784 bytes available. But cap=1024! My code: `len = Math.Min(seq.Length=9784, buffer.Length=1024) = 1024`. Copies 1024 bytes, AdvanceTo(consumed=1024, examined=seq.End). Returns 1024. The log line prints seq.Length (9784), not len — misleading, but the behavior is: consumed 1024, examined everything.
3. `write len=1` — server writes the newline.
4. `read got=8761` — remaining 9784-1024=8760 + 1 newline = 8761. Consumes 1024, examines the end. Returns 1024.
5. `read wait cap=1024` — next read... should get the remaining 7737 bytes. But it's stuck!

Why? **`AdvanceTo(consumed, examined)` with examined=seq.End**: after step 2, we examined up to the end of the 9784-byte buffer. The pipe remembers "examined up to position X". When the writer adds 1 byte (newline), ReadAsync returns because there's new data beyond the examined position. The buffer now contains the unconsumed 8760 + 1 = 8761. We consume 1024 and examine seq.End again. Next ReadAsync: there's still 7737 bytes of unconsumed data — but we've already examined up to the end! **The pipe won't return from ReadAsync until new data arrives beyond the examined position, even if unconsumed data remains!**

This is a classic PipeReader misuse: when you examine everything but only consume part, the next ReadAsync blocks until more data is written — because from the pipe's perspective, "you've already seen all of this data and chose not to consume it; I'll only wake you when there's something new."

Wait, is that really true? Let me recall the exact semantics of PipeReader.AdvanceTo(consumed, examined): "examined: the position up to which the data has been examined. ReadAsync will not return until there is data beyond this position, or the writer completes." Hmm — actually, the documented behavior is: if examined > consumed, the next ReadAsync returns immediately if there's unconsumed data? No...

The actual documented contract (from the System.IO.Pipelines docs):
- consumed: data up to this position is removed from the buffer.
- examined: data up to this position has been examined; ReadAsync won't return until there's more data than this (or IsCompleted), even if unconsumed data remains.

Yes — that's exactly the "backpressure" mechanism: examining everything signals "I've parsed everything available and need more bytes to make progress." So if you consume 1024 out of 9784 and examine the end, the next ReadAsync blocks even though 8760 unconsumed bytes remain. That's the bug — the trace confirms it: after `read got=8761`, the next `read wait` never completes (no more writes are coming; the server is waiting for the next request).

The correct pattern for a Stream adapter (indiscriminate byte copying, no parsing): **examined = consumed** (i.e., `AdvanceTo(seq.GetPosition(len))` — the single-argument overload sets examined=consumed). This tells the pipe "everything I consumed is done; I haven't examined anything beyond that," so the next ReadAsync returns immediately if data remains.

Fix: `_reader.AdvanceTo(seq.GetPosition(len));`

This is the standard Stream-over-Pipe adapter pattern. My "examined=seq.End" optimization was wrong for a raw stream copy.

Also, fix the misleading trace (print len) — actually, I'll just remove the trace entirely after verification. Let me fix AdvanceTo, keep the trace for one more run to confirm, then remove it.

Actually, let me just fix it and remove the trace in the same edit — the diagnosis is conclusive. But it's safer to verify with the trace still in place... the fix is unambiguous; remove the trace, rebuild, run, and verify end-to-end via /api/status. If it works, done.

Found the cause: it's a classic PipeReader misuse. The read buffer is only 1024 bytes, but the tools/list response is 9784 bytes. After consuming 1024 bytes, I was passing `examined: seq.End` to `AdvanceTo`—this tells the pipe "I've finished examining all the data, and I won't wake up until new data arrives," so the remaining 8760 bytes will never be read again, causing a deadlock. For a raw byte stream copy, `examined` must be equal to `consumed`.

  "content": "using System.IO.Pipelines;\n\nnamespace EduAgent.Web;\n\n// 进程内 MCP 通道：两条内存管道构成全双工链路，服务端/客户端各持一端，\n// 替代 stdio 子进程（IIS inprocess 托管下不依赖 dotnet 命令与平行输出目录）\npublic sealed class InProcessMcpLink : IDisposable\n{\n    private readonly Pipe _clientToServer = new();\n    private readonly Pipe _serverToClient = new();\n\n    public Stream ServerInput { get; }\n    public Stream ServerOutput { get; }\n    public Stream ClientWrite { get; }\n    public Stream ClientRead { get; }\n\n    public InProcessMcpLink()\n    {\n        ServerInput = new PipeStream(_clientToServer.Reader);\n        ServerOutput = new PipeStream(_serverToClient.Writer);\n        ClientWrite = new PipeStream(_clientToServer.Writer);\n        ClientRead = new PipeStream(_serverToClient.Reader);\n    }\n\n    public void Dispose()\n    {\n        _clientToServer.Reader.Complete();\n        _clientToServer.Writer.Complete();\n        _serverToClient.Reader.Complete();\n        _serverToClient.Writer.Complete();\n    }\n}\n\ninternal sealed class PipeStream : Stream\n{\n    private readonly PipeReader? _reader;\n    private readonly PipeWriter? _writer;\n\n    public PipeStream(PipeReader reader) => _reader = reader;\n    public PipeStream(PipeWriter writer) => _writer = writer;\n\n    public override bool CanRead => _reader != null;\n    public override bool CanWrite => _writer != null;\n    public override bool CanSeek => false;\n    public override long Length => throw new NotSupportedException();\n    public override long Position { get => throw new NotSupportedException(); set => throw new NotSupportedException(); }\n    public override void Flush() { }\n    public override Task FlushAsync(CancellationToken ct) => Task.CompletedTask;\n    public override long Seek(long offset, SeekOrigin origin) => throw new NotSupportedException();\n    public override void SetLength(long value) => throw new NotSupportedException();\n\n    public override int Read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) =>\n        ReadAsync(buffer.AsMemory(offset, count)).AsTask().GetAwaiter().GetResult();\n\n    public override async ValueTask<int> ReadAsync(Memory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken ct = default)\n    {\n        var result = await _reader!.ReadAsync(ct);\n        var seq = result.Buffer;\n        if (seq.IsEmpty && result.IsCompleted) return 0;\n        var len = (int)Math.Min(seq.Length, buffer.Length);\n        seq.Slice(0, len).CopyTo(buffer.Span);\n        _reader.AdvanceTo(seq.GetPosition(len), seq.End);\n        return len;\n    }\n\n    public override void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count) =>\n        WriteAsync(buffer.AsMemory(offset, count)).AsTask().GetAwaiter().GetResult();\n\n    public override async ValueTask WriteAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken ct = default)\n    {\n        var flush = await _writer!.WriteAsync(buffer, ct);\n        if (flush.IsCompleted) throw new IOException(\"进程内 MCP 管道已关闭\");\n    }\n}",

Now I've got the full picture. Minimal, focused fixes:

1. **`getJson`** (line 168): check `r.ok`. If not ok, read the body, try to parse `{error}`, and throw an Error with the server's message. This way, all tab loaders will display the actual error instead of a JSON parse error.

```js
async function getJson(url){
  const r=await api(url);
  if(!r.ok){
    let msg='请求失败（'+r.status+'）';
    try{const j=await r.json();if(j&&j.error)msg=j.error;}catch{}
    throw new Error(msg);
  }
  return r.json();
}
```

2. **`CallToolAsync`**: if `result.IsError`, throw `InvalidOperationException` with the error text — this way the endpoint returns 500 instead of returning error text as 200 JSON.

3. **JSON exception handler** in Program.cs so that 500s carry `{error: message}`:
```csharp
app.UseExceptionHandler(err => err.Run(async ctx =>
{
    var ex = ctx.Features.Get<IExceptionHandlerFeature>()?.Error;
    ctx.Response.StatusCode = 500;
    await ctx.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(new { error = ex?.Message ?? "服务器内部错误" });
}));
```
Needs `using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics;`. Place it early in the pipeline (before auth/endpoints). In Development, the developer exception page also handles things — `UseExceptionHandler` takes precedence for API JSON. No problem.

Wait — but the chat endpoint streams SSE. If an exception occurs mid-stream, the handler can't rewrite it. That's fine, it's an edge case.

Also, `restoreChat` uses `getJson` too — it'll benefit as well.

#### Thinking

Wait — there's one problem with the placement of UseExceptionHandler: it's after UseAuthorization, but the exception handler middleware needs to wrap the endpoints — the position relative to auth doesn't matter much. It catches exceptions from downstream (endpoints). It's before the endpoint mappings (which come later in the file), so it wraps them. OK.

But there's a subtle point: UseExceptionHandler re-executes the pipeline... no, with the lambda overload it just runs the handler. No problem.

Also, the SSE chat endpoint: if an exception occurs before streaming starts, the handler returns JSON 500 — the frontend chat handles it... the chat's fetch reads SSE lines. A JSON error body would be ignored / result in an empty response. Edge case, acceptable.

本地 404 已查明并解决：是一个旧的 dotnet 实例占着 5080 端口（它没有正确加载静态文件），新实例一直绑定失败。已终止旧进程并重启，现在本地一切正常：

- `GET /` → 200，页面正常
- `/api/status` → 大模型已连接，11 个工具全部就绪
- Development 环境，日志正常

**云端那边还差最后一步**：你遇到的 "An error occurred while saving the entity changes" 是 SQLite 写入权限问题（读没问题、写失败，所以侧栏能看、聊天报错）。在云服务器上用管理员 CMD 执行：

```bat
icacls "D:\EduData" /grant "IIS_IUSRS":(OI)(CI)M /T
```

然后在 IIS 里回收一次应用池，再试聊天。如果云端 web.config 里的 `EDU_DATA_DIR` 不是 `D:\EduData`，把命令里的路径换成你实际配置的路径。

另外 `publish/` 里已是包含全部错误显示修复的最新包，建议这次一并覆盖更新到云端（覆盖前保留你改过的 web.config）。

### **Assistant**

错误信息现在能完整显示了（说明新代码已生效），这个 `SQLite Error 8: attempt to write a readonly database` 就是**数据库写入权限不足**，和我之前判断一致。SQLite 的 WAL 模式写入时要在同目录创建 `-wal`/`-shm` 文件，所以**文件和文件夹都要有写权限**。

在云服务器上用**管理员身份**打开 CMD，依次执行（路径按你 web.config 里 `EDU_DATA_DIR` 的实际值调整）：

```bat
:: 1. 给 IIS 应用池组授予整个数据目录的修改权限（含子文件、继承）
icacls "D:\EduData" /grant "IIS_IUSRS":(OI)(CI)M /T

:: 2. 去掉可能存在的只读属性（从别的机器拷过来的文件常带这个）
attrib -R "D:\EduData\*.*" /S /D

:: 3. 确认权限已生效：输出里应能看到 IIS_IUSRS:(...)(M)
icacls "D:\EduData\eduagent.db"
```

然后**回收应用池**（IIS 管理器 → 应用程序池 → 右键你的池 → 回收），再试聊天。

两个注意点：

- 如果你的应用池不是默认的 `ApplicationPoolIdentity`，而是自定义账号，`IIS_IUSRS` 不覆盖它，需要把命令里的 `IIS_IUSRS` 换成那个账号（如 `IIS AppPool\你的池名`）。
- 如果执行后仍报同样错误，把 `icacls "D:\EduData"` 和 `icacls "D:\EduData\eduagent.db"` 的输出发我，我看具体 ACL。

#### Thinking

The cloud error is now clear: SQLite Error 8 "attempt to write a readonly database". This confirms it's a write permission issue. The user probably ran icacls, or maybe hasn't run it yet. The inner exception is now being displayed correctly (good — the fix is working).

"attempt to write a readonly database" in SQLite can be caused by:
1. The app pool identity doesn't have write permission on the DB file or directory (WAL needs directory write permission).
2. The DB file itself has the read-only attribute set.
3. The file was copied with read-only permissions, or is owned by another user.
4. The connection string has "Mode=ReadOnly" — unlikely.
5. The directory doesn't exist / the path is wrong — but in that case it would be a different error.

Also, if the DB file was copied from another machine, it may have the read-only attribute set. Check: `attrib D:\EduData\eduagent.db`.

Present clear steps to the user:
1. Run icacls granting Modify permission to IIS_IUSRS on D:\EduData (recursive).
2. Remove the read-only attribute: `attrib -R D:\EduData\*.* /S`
3. Also grant permissions to the app pool identity itself — IIS_IUSRS covers the app pool identity only if the app pool is running as ApplicationPoolIdentity (the default). If it's a custom identity, grant permissions to that one.
4. Recycle the app pool.

Also note: if the DB was created by a different process (e.g., previously run as admin), the file ACL may deny writes. icacls /grant adds permissions, but if there's an explicit Deny... unlikely though.

Another possibility: the user ran icacls but the error persists — did they recycle? Or the actual data directory is different. Ask them to confirm the path in web.config matches.

Also WAL: even if the db file is writable, if the directory isn't writable, you get "attempt to write a readonly database" when creating -wal. So directory permission is key.

Provide a single batch of commands to run as admin:

```bat
icacls "D:\EduData" /grant "IIS_IUSRS":(OI)(CI)M /T
attrib -R "D:\EduData\*.*" /S /D
iisreset  (or recycle the app pool)
```

Actually, iisreset is heavier; recycling the app pool is sufficient. But the simplest is: `iisreset` — the user is operating their own server; no problem, but it affects all sites. Recommend recycling the app pool via IIS Manager, or `%windir%\system32\inetsrv\appcmd recycle apppool /apppool.name:"YourAppPoolName"`.

Also verify: check the current ACL with `icacls D:\EduData\eduagent.db` and confirm whether IIS_IUSRS appears.

Keep the response concise, with steps and verification. Close with options per preference? The user is in the middle of debugging; a short menu is fine, but maybe minimal is okay. Memory says close turns with 2–4 concrete options. Keep it short.

145	<script>
146	const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
147	const msgs=$('#messages'), input=$('#input'), send=$('#send'), sideBody=$('#sideBody');
148	const sessionId='main';
149	let busy=false;
150	let token=localStorage.getItem('edu_token')||'';
151	let me=null;
152	
153	function esc(s){return (s||'').replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));}
154	function fmt(s){return esc(s).replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g,'<b>$1</b>').replace(/\n/g,'<br>');}
155	function addMsg(cls,html){const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='msg '+cls;d.innerHTML=html;msgs.appendChild(d);msgs.scrollTop=msgs.scrollHeight;return d;}
156	function addTools(){const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='tools';msgs.appendChild(d);return d;}
157	function addChip(box,name){const c=document.createElement('span');c.className='chip';c.innerHTML='🔧 <b>'+esc(name)+'</b>';box.appendChild(c);msgs.scrollTop=msgs.scrollHeight;}
158	function maskPhone(p){return p?p.slice(0,3)+'****'+p.slice(7):'';}
159	
160	// ---- auth ----
161	function authHeaders(extra){return Object.assign({'Authorization':'Bearer '+token},extra||{});}
162	async function api(url,opts){
163	  opts=opts||{};opts.headers=authHeaders(opts.headers);
164	  const r=await fetch(url,opts);
165	  if(r.status===401){showLogin();throw new Error('登录已过期，请重新登录');}
166	  return r;
167	}
168	async function getJson(url){
169	  const r=await api(url);
170	  if(!r.ok){
171	    let msg='请求失败（HTTP '+r.status+'）';
172	    try{const j=await r.json();if(j&&j.error)msg=j.error;}catch{}
173	    throw new Error(msg);
174	  }
175	  return r.json();
176	}
177	
178	function showLogin(){
179	  $('#app').style.display='none';
180	  $('#login').style.display='flex';
181	}
182	function enterApp(){
183	  $('#login').style.display='none';
184	  $('#app').style.display='flex';
185	  $('#userName').textContent=(me&&me.nickName?me.nickName:'同学')+' · '+maskPhone(me&&me.phone);
186	  restoreChat();
187	  loadStatus();refreshSide();
188	}
189	const WELCOME='你好，我是小智老师 👋 可以帮你讲解知识点、出针对性练习、批改作答、记录错题，还会安排复习。你的学习数据只属于你自己。先试试快捷按钮，或直接告诉我今天想练什么。';
190	async function restoreChat(){
191	  msgs.innerHTML='';
192	  try{
193	    const h=await getJson('/api/chat-history');
194	    if(Array.isArray(h)&&h.length){
195	      for(const m of h) addMsg(m.role==='user'?'user':'bot', m.role==='user'?esc(m.content):fmt(m.content));
196	      addMsg('sys','—— 以上为历史对话，重启后依然保留，小智老师记得你们聊过的内容 ——');
197	    }else addMsg('sys',WELCOME);
198	  }catch(e){addMsg('sys',WELCOME);}
199	}
200	function logout(){
201	  token='';me=null;
202	  localStorage.removeItem('edu_token');localStorage.removeItem('edu_user');
203	  $('#code').value='';$('#loginErr').textContent='';$('#codeHint').textContent='';
204	  showLogin();
205	}
206	$('#logout').onclick=logout;
207	
208	let cooldown=0;
209	$('#sendCode').onclick=async()=>{
210	  if(cooldown>0)return;
211	  const phone=$('#phone').value.trim();
212	  $('#loginErr').textContent='';
213	  try{
214	    const r=await fetch('/api/auth/send-code',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({phone})});
215	    const j=await r.json();
216	    if(!r.ok){$('#loginErr').textContent=j.error||'发送失败';return;}
217	    $('#codeHint').textContent='验证码已发送（演示固定 123456）';
218	    cooldown=30;const btn=$('#sendCode');btn.disabled=true;
219	    const t=setInterval(()=>{cooldown--;btn.textContent=cooldown>0?cooldown+'s':'获取验证码';if(cooldown<=0){clearInterval(t);btn.disabled=false;}},1000);
220	  }catch(e){$('#loginErr').textContent='请求失败：'+e.message;}
221	};
222	$('#doLogin').onclick=async()=>{
223	  const phone=$('#phone').value.trim(),code=$('#code').value.trim();
224	  $('#loginErr').textContent='';
225	  const btn=$('#doLogin');btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='登录中…';
226	  try{
227	    const r=await fetch('/api/auth/login',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({phone,code})});
228	    const j=await r.json();
229	    if(!r.ok){$('#loginErr').textContent=j.error||'登录失败';return;}
230	    token=j.token;me=j.user;
231	    localStorage.setItem('edu_token',token);localStorage.setItem('edu_user',JSON.stringify(me));
232	    enterApp();
233	  }catch(e){$('#loginErr').textContent='请求失败：'+e.message;}
234	  finally{btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='登录 / 注册';}
235	};
236	$('#code').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')$('#doLogin').click();});
237	
238	async function loadStatus(){
239	  try{
240	    const r=await fetch('/api/status');const j=await r.json();
241	    const el=$('#status');
242	    if(j.llmConfigured){el.classList.add('on');$('#statusText').textContent='大模型已连接 · '+j.toolCount+' 个工具';}
243	    else{$('#statusText').textContent='未配置大模型 Key（自检可用）';}
244	  }catch(e){$('#statusText').textContent='服务未就绪';}
245	}

247	async function sendMessage(text){
248	  if(busy||!text.trim())return;
249	  busy=true;send.disabled=true;
250	  addMsg('user',esc(text));
251	  input.value='';input.style.height='auto';
252	  const toolBox=addTools();
253	  const bot=addMsg('bot','');
254	  let acc='';
255	  try{
256	    const resp=await api('/api/chat',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({sessionId,message:text})});
257	    if(!resp.ok){let msg='HTTP '+resp.status;try{const j=await resp.json();if(j&&j.error)msg=j.error;}catch{}throw new Error(msg);}
258	    const reader=resp.body.getReader();const dec=new TextDecoder();let buf='';
259	    while(true){
260	      const {done,value}=await reader.read();if(done)break;
261	      buf+=dec.decode(value,{stream:true});
262	      const parts=buf.split('\n\n');buf=parts.pop();
263	      for(const p of parts){
264	        const line=p.trim();if(!line.startsWith('data:'))continue;
265	        let ev;try{ev=JSON.parse(line.slice(5).trim());}catch{continue;}
266	        if(ev.type==='tool'){addChip(toolBox,ev.name);}
267	        else if(ev.type==='delta'){acc+=ev.text;bot.innerHTML=fmt(acc);msgs.scrollTop=msgs.scrollHeight;}
268	        else if(ev.type==='error'){bot.innerHTML='<span style="color:#d64545">'+esc(ev.message)+'</span>';}
269	      }
270	    }
271	    if(!acc&&!bot.innerHTML)bot.innerHTML='<span style="color:var(--sub)">（无回复）</span>';
272	    if(toolBox.childElementCount===0)toolBox.remove();
273	  }catch(e){bot.innerHTML='<span style="color:#d64545">请求失败：'+esc(e.message)+'</span>';}
274	  busy=false;send.disabled=false;input.focus();
275	  refreshSide();
276	}
277	
278	send.onclick=()=>sendMessage(input.value);
279	input.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'&&!e.shiftKey){e.preventDefault();sendMessage(input.value);}});
280	input.addEventListener('input',()=>{input.style.height='auto';input.style.height=Math.min(input.scrollHeight,120)+'px';});
281	document.querySelectorAll('.quick button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>sendMessage(b.dataset.q));

286	
287	function renderSummary(j){
288	  const m=j.mastery||{};
289	  return `<div class="card"><h4>练习概况</h4>
290	    <div class="stat"><span>累计作答</span><b>${j.totalAttempts||0}</b></div>
291	    <div class="stat"><span>答对</span><b>${j.correctAttempts||0}</b></div>
292	    <div class="stat"><span>正确率</span><b>${Math.round((j.correctRate||0)*100)}%</b></div>
293	    <div class="stat"><span>近7天练习</span><b>${(j.last7Days&&j.last7Days.attempts)||0}</b></div>
294	  </div>
295	  <div class="card"><h4>知识点掌握</h4>
296	    <div class="stat"><span>已掌握</span><b style="color:var(--ok)">${m.mastered||0}</b></div>
297	    <div class="stat"><span>学习中</span><b style="color:var(--warn)">${m.learning||0}</b></div>
298	    <div class="stat"><span>已衰减</span><b style="color:#d64545">${m.decayed||0}</b></div>
299	    <div class="stat"><span>未开始</span><b>${m.notStarted||0}</b></div>
300	  </div>
301	  <div class="card"><h4>待办</h4>
302	    <div class="stat"><span>未解决错题</span><b>${j.openWrongQuestions||0}</b></div>
303	    <div class="stat"><span>到期复习</span><b>${j.dueReviews||0}</b></div>
304	  </div>`;
305	}
306	function renderMastery(arr){

57	    public async Task StartAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
58	    {
59	        // 进程内 MCP：Server 与 Web 共享同一进程/DI（知识库与 ONNX 模型只加载一份），
60	        // 内存管道替代 stdio 子进程，IIS inprocess 托管无需 dotnet 命令与平行输出目录
61	        var transport = new StreamClientTransport(_link.ClientWrite, _link.ClientRead, _loggerFactory);
62	        _client = await McpClient.CreateAsync(transport, cancellationToken: ct);
63	        var tools = await _client.ListToolsAsync(cancellationToken: ct);
64	        _tools = tools.ToList();
65	        ToolNames = tools.Select(t => t.Name).ToList();
66	        _logger.LogInformation("MCP Server 已连接，发现 {Count} 个工具: {Tools}", tools.Count, string.Join(", ", ToolNames));
67	
68	        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_llm.ApiKey))
69	        {
70	            _logger.LogWarning("未配置 Llm.ApiKey，聊天不可用；MCP 工具与 /api/selftest 仍可验证。");
71	            return;
72	        }
73	
74	        _openAi = new OpenAIClient(
75	            new ApiKeyCredential(_llm.ApiKey),
76	            new OpenAIClientOptions { Endpoint = new Uri(_llm.Endpoint) });
77	    }
