79	    // 每次聊天按登录用户构建 Kernel：userId 直接闭包绑定进工具桥接，
80	    // 不依赖 AsyncLocal（其在 SK 自动调用工具时不会可靠流动），杜绝大模型伪造他人 userId
81	    private Kernel BuildKernel(string userId)
82	    {
83	        var builder = Kernel.CreateBuilder();
84	        builder.AddOpenAIChatCompletion(_llm.Model, _openAi!);
85	        var kernel = builder.Build();
86	        kernel.ImportPluginFromFunctions("edu", _tools.Select(t => CreateBridge(t, userId)));
87	        kernel.ImportPluginFromFunctions("skills", [CreateLoadSkill()]);
88	        return kernel;
89	    }

91	    // 通用桥接：MCP 工具的 JsonSchema → KernelParameterMetadata，调用时转发到 MCP Server
92	    private KernelFunction CreateBridge(McpClientTool tool, string userId)
93	    {
94	        var schema = tool.ProtocolTool.InputSchema;
95	        var required = new HashSet<string>();
96	        if (schema.TryGetProperty("required", out var reqEl) && reqEl.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
97	            foreach (var r in reqEl.EnumerateArray())
98	                if (r.GetString() is { } s) required.Add(s);
99	
100	        var parameters = new List<KernelParameterMetadata>();
101	        if (schema.TryGetProperty("properties", out var props) && props.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object)
102	        {
103	            foreach (var p in props.EnumerateObject())
104	            {
105	                parameters.Add(new KernelParameterMetadata(p.Name)
106	                {
107	                    Description = p.Value.TryGetProperty("description", out var d) ? d.GetString() ?? "" : "",
108	                    ParameterType = MapType(p.Value),
109	                    IsRequired = required.Contains(p.Name)
110	                });
111	            }
112	        }
113	
114	        return KernelFunctionFactory.CreateFromMethod(
115	            async (KernelArguments args, CancellationToken ct) =>
116	            {
117	                var callArgs = new Dictionary<string, object?>();
118	                foreach (var pm in parameters)
119	                    if (args.TryGetValue(pm.Name, out var val) && Normalize(val) is { } norm)
120	                        callArgs[pm.Name] = norm;
121	
122	                // 数据隔离：userId 一律取自登录态（闭包绑定），覆盖大模型可能传入的任何值
123	                if (parameters.Any(p => p.Name == "userId"))
124	                    callArgs["userId"] = userId;
125	
126	                var result = await _client!.CallToolAsync(tool.Name, callArgs, cancellationToken: ct);
127	                var text = string.Join("\n", result.Content.OfType<TextContentBlock>().Select(b => b.Text));
128	                return result.IsError == true ? $"[工具错误] {text}" : text;
129	            },
130	            new KernelFunctionFromMethodOptions
131	            {
132	                FunctionName = tool.Name,
133	                Description = tool.Description ?? "",
134	                Parameters = parameters
135	            });
136	    }
137

140	        new KernelFunctionFromMethodOptions

144	            Parameters =

155	    private static Type MapType(JsonElement propSchema)
156	    {
157	        var type = "string";
158	        if (propSchema.TryGetProperty("type", out var t))
159	        {
160	            if (t.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String) type = t.GetString() ?? "string";
161	            else if (t.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
162	                type = t.EnumerateArray().Select(x => x.GetString()).FirstOrDefault(x => x != "null") ?? "string";
163	        }
164	        return type switch
165	        {
166	            "integer" => typeof(long),
167	            "number" => typeof(double),
168	            "boolean" => typeof(bool),
169	            _ => typeof(string)
170	        };
171	    }
172	
173	    private static object? Normalize(object? v) => v switch
174	    {
175	        null => null,
176	        JsonElement je => je.ValueKind switch
177	        {
178	            JsonValueKind.String => je.GetString(),
179	            JsonValueKind.Number => je.TryGetInt64(out var l) ? l : je.GetDouble(),
180	            JsonValueKind.True => true,
181	            JsonValueKind.False => false,
182	            JsonValueKind.Null => null,
183	            _ => je.GetRawText()
184	        },
185	        _ => v
186	    };

188	    public async IAsyncEnumerable<string> ChatStreamAsync(
189	        string sessionId, string userMessage, string userId, [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken ct = default)
190	    {
191	        if (_openAi == null)
192	        {
193	            yield return Sse(new { type = "error", message = "尚未配置大模型 API Key。请在 appsettings.json 的 Llm.ApiKey 填入 DeepSeek（或其他 OpenAI 兼容服务）密钥后重启。工具自检 /api/selftest 无需 Key 即可运行。" });
194	            yield break;
195	        }
196	
197	        var history = await GetOrCreateHistoryAsync(userId, sessionId);
198	        history.AddUserMessage(userMessage);
199	        await PersistMessageAsync(userId, sessionId, "user", userMessage);
200	
201	        var settings = new OpenAIPromptExecutionSettings
202	        {
203	            ToolCallBehavior = ToolCallBehavior.AutoInvokeKernelFunctions,
204	            Temperature = 0.4
205	        };
206	        var kernel = BuildKernel(userId);
207	        var chat = kernel.GetRequiredService<IChatCompletionService>();
208	        var full = new StringBuilder();
209	        var seenCalls = new HashSet<string>();
210	
211	        await foreach (var chunk in chat.GetStreamingChatMessageContentsAsync(history, settings, kernel, ct))
212	        {
213	            foreach (var item in chunk.Items)
214	                if (item is StreamingFunctionCallUpdateContent fc
215	                    && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(fc.Name)
216	                    && fc.CallId is { } callId
217	                    && seenCalls.Add(callId))
218	                    yield return Sse(new { type = "tool", name = fc.Name });
219	
220	            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(chunk.Content))
221	            {
222	                full.Append(chunk.Content);
223	                yield return Sse(new { type = "delta", text = chunk.Content });
224	            }
225	        }
226	
227	        if (full.Length > 0)
228	        {
229	            history.AddAssistantMessage(full.ToString());
230	            await PersistMessageAsync(userId, sessionId, "assistant", full.ToString());
231	        }
232	        TrimHistory(history);
233	        yield return Sse(new { type = "done" });
234	    }
235	
236	    // 会话历史持久化：内存缓存命中则直接用，否则从 DB 恢复（重启后仍可接续上下文）
237	    private async Task<ChatHistory> GetOrCreateHistoryAsync(string userId, string sessionId)
238	    {
239	        var key = userId + "|" + sessionId;
240	        if (_sessions.TryGetValue(key, out var cached)) return cached;
241	
242	        var h = new ChatHistory();
243	        h.AddSystemMessage(_systemPrompt);
244	        using (var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope())
245	        {
246	            var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<EduDbContext>();
247	            var prior = await db.ChatMessages
248	                .Where(c => c.UserId == userId && c.SessionId == sessionId)
249	                .OrderByDescending(c => c.CreatedAt).ThenByDescending(c => c.Id)
250	                .Take(40)
251	                .ToListAsync();
252	            foreach (var m in prior.OrderBy(c => c.CreatedAt).ThenBy(c => c.Id))
253	            {
254	                if (m.Role == "user") h.AddUserMessage(m.Content);
255	                else if (m.Role == "assistant") h.AddAssistantMessage(m.Content);
256	            }
257	        }
258	        _sessions[key] = h;
259	        return h;
260	    }
261	
262	    private async Task PersistMessageAsync(string userId, string sessionId, string role, string content)
263	    {
264	        using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope();
265	        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<EduDbContext>();
266	        db.ChatMessages.Add(new ChatMessage
267	        {
268	            UserId = userId,
269	            SessionId = sessionId,
270	            Role = role,
271	            Content = content,
272	            CreatedAt = DateTime.Now
273	        });
274	        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
275	    }

277	    // 供 /api/selftest 直接调用 MCP 工具（绕过大模型），验证全链路
278	    public async Task<string> CallToolAsync(string name, Dictionary<string, object?>? args = null, CancellationToken ct = default)
279	    {
280	        if (_client == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("MCP 客户端未启动");
281	        var result = await _client.CallToolAsync(name, args, cancellationToken: ct);
282	        var text = string.Join("\n", result.Content.OfType<TextContentBlock>().Select(b => b.Text));
283	        if (result.IsError == true) throw new InvalidOperationException(text);
284	        return text;
285	    }

287	    private static void TrimHistory(ChatHistory h)
288	    {
289	        const int max = 40;
290	        while (h.Count > max) h.RemoveAt(1);
291	    }

Use anonymous object + JsonSerializer with camelCase? Property names need to be snake_case: image_url. Use Dictionary or explicit JsonNode. The easiest is to build with an anonymous type usingJsonPropertyName? Anonymous types can't have attributes. Use Dictionary<string, object?>:

POST with HttpRequestMessage, Authorization Bearer. Response: parse choices[0].message.content. Strip fences: if content starts with ``` → remove the first line and the trailing ```. Then deserialize into a JsonElement and extract fields leniently.

Return the record. On HTTP error: read the body, log it, and throw InvalidOperationException with a friendly message (e.g., "视觉模型调用失败：..."). For invalid API key, DashScope returns 401 with an error message.

Next, the Program.cs endpoint:

```csharp
app.MapPost("/api/wrong-photo", async (HttpContext ctx, IFormFile? file, VisionService vision, KnowledgeService kb, McpAgentService a) =>
{
    if (!vision.Configured)
        return Results.BadRequest(new { error = "拍照识题未启用：请在配置中填入 Vision:ApiKey（阿里云 DashScope），或在 web.config 增加环境变量 EDU_VISION_APIKEY。" });
    if (file == null || file.Length == 0)
        return Results.BadRequest(new { error = "请选择要上传的照片" });
    if (file.Length > 8 * 1024 * 1024)
        return Results.BadRequest(new { error = "照片不能超过 8MB" });
    if (!file.ContentType.StartsWith("image/"))
        return Results.BadRequest(new { error = "只支持图片文件" });

    using var ms = new MemoryStream();
    await file.CopyToAsync(ms, ctx.RequestAborted);
    var r = await vision.AnalyzeWrongPhotoAsync(ms.ToArray(), file.ContentType, kb.GetTreeText(), ctx.RequestAborted);
    if (!r.Readable)
        return Results.BadRequest(new { error = r.Reason ?? "图片无法识别，请拍清楚题目后重试" });

    var node = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r.NodeId) ? null : kb.GetNode(r.NodeId);
    if (node == null)
        return Results.Json(new { ok = true, recorded = false, questionText = r.QuestionText, studentAnswer = r.StudentAnswer, analysis = r.Analysis });

    var rec = await a.CallToolAsync("record_wrong_question", new Dictionary<string, object?>
    {
        ["userId"] = ctx.User.GetUserId(),
        ["nodeId"] = node.Id,
        ["questionText"] = r.QuestionText,
        ["studentAnswer"] = r.StudentAnswer,
        ["note"] = "拍照录入 · " + r.Analysis
    }, ctx.RequestAborted);
    var id = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<JsonElement>(rec).GetProperty("id").GetString();
    return Results.Json(new { ok = true, recorded = true, id, nodeId = node.Id, nodeName = node.Name, questionText = r.QuestionText, studentAnswer = r.StudentAnswer, analysis = r.Analysis });
}).RequireAuthorization();
```

Note: record_wrong_question returns {recorded, id, nodeId, status, createdAt} — ToJson is probably camelCase (check ToJson in EducationTools — it uses ToJson, probably camelCase; the self-test reads "questionId" from generate_practice, so yes, camelCase).

Also, if the tool returns an error JSON {error, tree} (invalid node), CallToolAsync doesn't throw (IsError is false, it's just text). Since we validate the node beforehand, no problem.

Multipart binding: minimal API using IFormFile requires `[FromForm]`? In .NET 8+, IFormFile is automatically inferred from form binding in MapPost. Yes, IFormFile parameters are bound from the form. Need anti-forgery? In .NET 8, form binding in minimal APIs requires anti-forgery validation only when using [FromForm] with a record? Actually, .NET 8 added anti-forgery middleware requirements for form binding in minimal APIs: "When binding from forms, anti-forgery validation is required" — does this apply to IFormFile too? Let me recall: in .NET 8, minimal APIs that bind from forms (including IFormFile) require anti-forgery services and token validation, unless disabled. Yes — ASP.NET Core 8 introduced mandatory anti-forgery for form binding in minimal APIs. If anti-forgery isn't configured, you get an InvalidOperationException at request time: "Antiforgery validation is required...". Options: add `builder.Services.AddAntiforgery()` and have the frontend send the token — complicated. Or `.DisableAntiforgery()` on the endpoint (available in .NET 8+). Since we're using JWT Bearer auth (not cookies), CSRF risk is low (the Authorization header isn't auto-attached cross-site). Use `.DisableAntiforgery()` with a brief comment. This is the pragmatic approach for JWT APIs.

```css
.quick{flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;padding:0 12px 8px}
.quick button{flex-shrink:0}
#composer{padding:10px 12px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
#input{font-size:16px}  /* prevent iOS zoom on focus */
.loginCard{width:min(92vw,360px);padding:28px 22px}
body{height:100dvh}
```

Default for #sideToggle: display:none; styled as a button. Place it in the header before status. Text: "学情 ☰"? Use "📊 学情". Keep it simple: "学情".

Also, close the drawer when a tab is selected? Leave it open so the user can browse; close via mask click or toggle. Also add a close button inside side for mobile? Mask click + toggle is enough.

JS:
```js
const side=$('#side'), sideMask=$('#sideMask');
function toggleSide(open){ side.classList.toggle('open',open); sideMask.classList.toggle('show',open); }
$('#sideToggle').onclick=()=>toggleSide(!side.classList.contains('open'));
sideMask.onclick=()=>toggleSide(false);
```

Photo:
```js
const photoBtn=$('#photoBtn'), photoInput=$('#photoInput');
let visionOn=false;
// inside loadStatus: visionOn=!!j.visionConfigured; photoBtn.style.display=visionOn?'':'none';
photoBtn.onclick=()=>{ if(!busy) photoInput.click(); };
photoInput.onchange=async()=>{ const f=photoInput.files[0]; photoInput.value=''; if(f) await uploadWrongPhoto(f); };

async function compressImage(file){
  const bmp=await createImageBitmap(file);
  const max=1600, scale=Math.min(1,max/Math.max(bmp.width,bmp.height));
  const w=Math.round(bmp.width*scale), h=Math.round(bmp.height*scale);
  const cv=document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width=w; cv.height=h;
  cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(bmp,0,0,w,h);
  bmp.close();
  const blob=await new Promise(res=>cv.toBlob(res,'image/jpeg',0.85));
  return blob||file;
}
```
createImageBitmap is widely supported. Fallback: if createImageBitmap is undefined, use the original file. Keep it simple with try/catch → return file.

uploadWrongPhoto:
```js
async function uploadWrongPhoto(file){
  if(busy)return; busy=true; send.disabled=true; photoBtn.disabled=true;
  const blob=await compressImage(file);
  const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  addMsg('user','<img class="pthumb" src="'+url+'" alt="错题照片">📷 拍照录入错题');
  const bot=addMsg('bot','正在识别题目，请稍候…');
  try{
    const fd=new FormData(); fd.append('file',blob,'wrong.jpg');
    const r=await api('/api/wrong-photo',{method:'POST',body:fd});
    const j=await r.json();
    if(!r.ok)throw new Error(j.error||'识别失败（HTTP '+r.status+'）');
    bot.innerHTML=renderPhotoResult(j);
    bindPhotoTrain(bot,j);
  }catch(e){bot.innerHTML='<span style="color:#d64545">识别失败：'+esc(e.message)+'</span>';}
  busy=false; send.disabled=false; photoBtn.disabled=false;
  refreshSide();
}
```

Note: the user msg uses an img with an object URL — no problem.

renderPhotoResult(j):
```js
function renderPhotoResult(j){
  let h='<div class="pcard"><div class="phead">📷 错题识别完成';
  if(j.recorded)h+=' <span class="badge b-Mastered">已入错题本</span>';
  h+='</div>';
  if(j.nodeName)h+='<div class="meta">知识点：'+esc(j.nodeName)+'</div>';
  h+='<div class="pq">'+esc(j.questionText)+'</div>';
  if(j.studentAnswer)h+='<div class="meta">孩子答案：'+esc(j.studentAnswer)+'</div>';
  if(j.analysis)h+='<div class="pa">💡 '+esc(j.analysis)+'</div>';
  if(j.recorded)h+='<button class="ptrain">开始相似题训练</button>';
  else h+='<div class="meta">暂未匹配到知识点，可让小智老师帮忙判断：</div><button class="ptrain pjudge">让小智老师判断知识点</button>';
  return h+'</div>';
}
function bindPhotoTrain(bot,j){
  const b=bot.querySelector('.ptrain'); if(!b)return;
  b.onclick=()=>{
    if(j.recorded) sendMessage('我在「'+j.nodeName+'」知识点上错了这道题：'+j.questionText+(j.studentAnswer?' 我的答案是'+j.studentAnswer:'')+'。请针对这个知识点（'+j.nodeId+'）出3道相似题帮我巩固，逐题出示。');
    else sendMessage('这道题属于哪个知识点？请先帮我判断并讲解思路：'+j.questionText);
  };
}
```

sendMessage checks busy — busy is false at that point. Good. Note: sendMessage clears the input, but that's fine.

Also, disable photoBtn while busy (sendMessage sets send.disabled but not photoBtn; add photoBtn.disabled handling inside sendMessage too). Simpler: inside sendMessage set photoBtn.disabled=true at start, false at end. photoBtn might be hidden, but that's fine.

247	async function sendMessage(text){
248	  if(busy||!text.trim())return;
249	  busy=true;send.disabled=true;
250	  addMsg('user',esc(text));
251	  input.value='';input.style.height='auto';
252	  const toolBox=addTools();
253	  const bot=addMsg('bot','');
254	  let acc='';
255	  try{
256	    const resp=await api('/api/chat',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({sessionId,message:text})});
257	    if(!resp.ok){let msg='HTTP '+resp.status;try{const j=await resp.json();if(j&&j.error)msg=j.error;}catch{}throw new Error(msg);}
258	    const reader=resp.body.getReader();const dec=new TextDecoder();let buf='';
259	    while(true){
260	      const {done,value}=await reader.read();if(done)break;
261	      buf+=dec.decode(value,{stream:true});
262	      const parts=buf.split('\n\n');buf=parts.pop();
263	      for(const p of parts){
264	        const line=p.trim();if(!line.startsWith('data:'))continue;
265	        let ev;try{ev=JSON.parse(line.slice(5).trim());}catch{continue;}
266	        if(ev.type==='tool'){addChip(toolBox,ev.name);}
267	        else if(ev.type==='delta'){acc+=ev.text;bot.innerHTML=fmt(acc);msgs.scrollTop=msgs.scrollHeight;}
268	        else if(ev.type==='error'){bot.innerHTML='<span style="color:#d64545">'+esc(ev.message)+'</span>';}
269	      }
270	    }
271	    if(!acc&&!bot.innerHTML)bot.innerHTML='<span style="color:var(--sub)">（无回复）</span>';
272	    if(toolBox.childElementCount===0)toolBox.remove();
273	  }catch(e){bot.innerHTML='<span style="color:#d64545">请求失败：'+esc(e.message)+'</span>';}
274	  busy=false;send.disabled=false;input.focus();
275	  refreshSide();
276	}

188	    public async IAsyncEnumerable<string> ChatStreamAsync(
189	        string sessionId, string userMessage, string userId, [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken ct = default)
190	    {
191	        if (_openAi == null)
192	        {
193	            yield return Sse(new { type = "error", message = "尚未配置大模型 API Key。请在 appsettings.json 的 Llm.ApiKey 填入 DeepSeek（或其他 OpenAI 兼容服务）密钥后重启。工具自检 /api/selftest 无需 Key 即可运行。" });
194	            yield break;
195	        }
196	
197	        var history = await GetOrCreateHistoryAsync(userId, sessionId);
198	        history.AddUserMessage(userMessage);
199	        await PersistMessageAsync(userId, sessionId, "user", userMessage);
200	
201	        var settings = new OpenAIPromptExecutionSettings
202	        {
203	            ToolCallBehavior = ToolCallBehavior.AutoInvokeKernelFunctions,
204	            Temperature = 0.4
205	        };
206	        var kernel = BuildKernel(userId);
207	        var chat = kernel.GetRequiredService<IChatCompletionService>();
208	        var full = new StringBuilder();
209	        var seenCalls = new HashSet<string>();
210	
211	        await foreach (var chunk in chat.GetStreamingChatMessageContentsAsync(history, settings, kernel, ct))
212	        {
213	            foreach (var item in chunk.Items)
214	                if (item is StreamingFunctionCallUpdateContent fc
215	                    && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(fc.Name)
216	                    && fc.CallId is { } callId
217	                    && seenCalls.Add(callId))
218	                    yield return Sse(new { type = "tool", name = fc.Name });
219	
220	            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(chunk.Content))
221	            {
222	                full.Append(chunk.Content);
223	                yield return Sse(new { type = "delta", text = chunk.Content });
224	            }
225	        }
226	
227	        if (full.Length > 0)
228	        {
229	            history.AddAssistantMessage(full.ToString());
230	            await PersistMessageAsync(userId, sessionId, "assistant", full.ToString());
231	        }
232	        TrimHistory(history);
233	        yield return Sse(new { type = "done" });
234	    }
235	
236	    // 会话历史持久化：内存缓存命中则直接用，否则从 DB 恢复（重启后仍可接续上下文）
237	    private async Task<ChatHistory> GetOrCreateHistoryAsync(string userId, string sessionId)
238	    {
239	        var key = userId + "|" + sessionId;
240	        if (_sessions.TryGetValue(key, out var cached)) return cached;
241	
242	        var h = new ChatHistory();
243	        h.AddSystemMessage(_systemPrompt);
244	        using (var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope())
245	        {
246	            var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<EduDbContext>();
247	            var prior = await db.ChatMessages
248	                .Where(c => c.UserId == userId && c.SessionId == sessionId)
249	                .OrderByDescending(c => c.CreatedAt).ThenByDescending(c => c.Id)
250	                .Take(40)
251	                .ToListAsync();
252	            foreach (var m in prior.OrderBy(c => c.CreatedAt).ThenBy(c => c.Id))
253	            {
254	                if (m.Role == "user") h.AddUserMessage(m.Content);
255	                else if (m.Role == "assistant") h.AddAssistantMessage(m.Content);
256	            }
257	        }
258	        _sessions[key] = h;
259	        return h;
260	    }
261	
262	    private async Task PersistMessageAsync(string userId, string sessionId, string role, string content)
263	    {
264	        using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope();
265	        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<EduDbContext>();
266	        db.ChatMessages.Add(new ChatMessage
267	        {
268	            UserId = userId,
269	            SessionId = sessionId,
270	            Role = role,
271	            Content = content,
272	            CreatedAt = DateTime.Now
273	        });
274	        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
275	    }

277	    // 供 /api/selftest 直接调用 MCP 工具（绕过大模型），验证全链路
278	    public async Task<string> CallToolAsync(string name, Dictionary<string, object?>? args = null, CancellationToken ct = default)
279	    {
280	        if (_client == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("MCP 客户端未启动");
281	        var result = await _client.CallToolAsync(name, args, cancellationToken: ct);
282	        var text = string.Join("\n", result.Content.OfType<TextContentBlock>().Select(b => b.Text));
283	        if (result.IsError == true) throw new InvalidOperationException(text);
284	        return text;
285	    }

288	    {
289	        const int max = 40;
290	        while (h.Count > max) h.RemoveAt(1);
291	    }

```json
  "new_string": "// ---- 拍照错题：视觉模型识别 → 匹配知识点 → 录入错题本 ----\n// JWT Bearer 认证（非 Cookie），无 CSRF 风险，故关闭表单防伪校验\napp.MapPost(\"/api/wrong-photo\", async (HttpContext ctx, IFormFile? file, VisionService vision, KnowledgeService kb, McpAgentService a) =>\n{\n    if (!vision.Configured)\n        return Results.BadRequest(new { error = \"拍照识题未启用：请在 appsettings.json 的 Vision:ApiKey 填入阿里云 DashScope Key（或配置环境变量 EDU_VISION_APIKEY）后重启。\" });\n    if (file == null || file.Length == 0)\n        return Results.BadRequest(new { error = \"请选择要上传的照片\" });\n    if (file.Length > 8 * 1024 * 1024)\n        return Results.BadRequest(new { error = \"照片不能超过 8MB，请拍小一点或裁剪后再传\" });\n    if (!file.ContentType.StartsWith(\"image/\"))\n        return Results.BadRequest(new { error = \"只支持图片文件\" });\n\n    using var ms = new MemoryStream();\n    await file.CopyToAsync(ms, ctx.RequestAborted);\n    var r = await vision.AnalyzeWrongPhotoAsync(ms.ToArray(), file.ContentType, kb.GetTreeText(), ctx.RequestAborted);\n    if (!r.Readable || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r.QuestionText))\n        return Results.BadRequest(new { error = r.Reason ?? 3. 刷新页面，输入框左边就会出现 📷 按钮
```

另外提醒：如果你现在看的是**云端页面**，那上面跑的还是旧包，即使配了 Key 也不会有按钮——需要先把最新 `publish/` 覆盖上去（保留你改过的 web.config）。
